lemmas.def_en: the state of being unable to produce offspring; in a woman it is an inability to conceive; in a man it is an inability to impregnate

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infertile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (心灵学用语)心灵运输(物体、人)
lemmas.def_en: transport by dematerializing at one point and assembling at another

examples.en: The device allowed the explorer to teleport instantly from the spacecraft down to the alien planet.
examples.zh: 该装置让探险家能够瞬间从宇宙飞船传送到外星球表面。

lemmas.usage_note: 科幻或奇幻语境动词，可及物或不及物，常与介词 to 或 into 连用表示瞬间移动。

lemmas.def_en: a hypothetical mode of instantaneous transportation; matter is dematerialized at one place and recreated at another

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teleport 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a servant who is employed to perform domestic task in a household

examples.en: The wealthy family hired an experienced housekeeper to supervise the domestic staff and manage daily chores.
examples.zh: 这个富裕家庭雇了一位经验丰富的女管家来监督家政人员并管理日常琐事。

lemmas.usage_note: 指受雇统筹管理家务的管家，多用于大户人家或酒店后勤管理语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 housekeeper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 信条, 教义, 宗旨, 原则
lemmas.def_en: a religious doctrine that is proclaimed as true without proof

examples.en: Freedom of expression is a fundamental tenet of modern democratic society.
examples.zh: 言论自由是现代民主社会的一项基本原则。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常与 of 连用，多搭配 central, basic 或 core 表示核心信仰或基本原则。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tenet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large shallow dish used for serving food

examples.en: The waiter brought out a large platter of grilled seafood garnished with fresh lemon slices.
examples.zh: 服务员端出了一大盘饰有新鲜柠檬片的烤海鲜。

lemmas.usage_note: 指端菜用的大浅盘，常构成 a platter of 结构，多用于餐饮与聚会场景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 platter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小妖, 小鬼, 妖精
lemmas.def_en: a small being, human in form, playful and having magical powers

examples.en: In ancient folklore, a playful water sprite was believed to inhabit the enchanted spring.
examples.zh: 在古老的民间传说中，人们相信有一只顽皮的水精灵居住在这座被施了魔法的泉水里。

lemmas.usage_note: 指神话中的小精灵或水妖；亦广泛用于计算机图形学指游戏中的二维精灵图。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sprite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 明晰的, 清澈的, 透明的, 透彻的
lemmas.def_en: (of language) transparently clear; easily understandable; ; ; - Robert Burton

examples.en: The professor gave a remarkably lucid explanation of the complex economic theory.
examples.zh: 教授对这一复杂的经济理论作出了极为透彻明晰的解释。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰解释、文风表示清晰透彻；亦指人在神志不清状态下突然恢复清醒。

lemmas.def_zh: 明朗, 清澈, 透明
lemmas.def_en: free from obscurity and easy to understand; the comprehensibility of clear expression
an act of explaining that serves to clear up and cast light on
in a clear and lucid manner

examples.en: this is a lucidly written book

lemmas.def_en: make clear and (more) comprehensible

examples.en: The professor used clear examples to elucidate the complex economic theory to students.
examples.zh: 教授用清晰的例子向学生们阐明了复杂的经济理论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lucid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a wrecked ship (or a part of one)

examples.en: Divers discovered the historic shipwreck at the bottom of the bay after months of searching.
examples.zh: 经过数月的搜寻，潜水员在海湾底部发现了这艘具有历史意义的沉船残骸。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指沉船事件（海难），也可指沉船残骸，常作可数名词，搭配 survive a shipwreck。

lemmas.def_zh: 遇海难, 毁灭, 使失事
lemmas.def_en: ruin utterly

examples.en: The sailors were shipwrecked on a deserted island when a violent gale smashed their vessel.
examples.zh: 当一场猛烈的强风吹毁船只时，水手们遭遇海难被迫滞留在了一座荒岛上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以被动语态 be shipwrecked 出现，表示因海难而遇险或漂泊到某处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shipwreck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 附属物, 附件, 助手, 修饰语
lemmas.def_en: something added to another thing but not an essential part of it

examples.en: Online exercises are intended as a useful adjunct to traditional classroom teaching.
examples.zh: 在线练习旨在作为传统课堂教学的有益补充。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，指补充物或附属机构，常与 to 搭配；在语法中指附加状语修饰成分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adjunct 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 激怒, 发怒, 提高价格, 吹胀；吹气, 恫吓, 发怒
lemmas.def_en: inhale recreational drugs

examples.en: He began to huff and puff loudly after carrying the heavy boxes up three flights of stairs.
examples.zh: 把那些沉重的箱子搬上三楼后，他开始大声地呼哧呼哧喘粗气。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，表因恼怒或疲惫而粗重喘息，常与 puff 连用构成 huff and puff，具口语色彩。

lemmas.def_en: quick to take offense
in a huffy manner

examples.en: `Don't bother to call me back,' he said huffily

family_guide.root_logic: 以 huff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 残忍的, 无人性的, 非人类的
lemmas.def_en: without compunction or human feeling

examples.en: The prisoners of war were subjected to cruel and inhuman treatment in the labor camp.
examples.zh: 战俘们在劳改营中遭受了残忍且毫无人性的虐待。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 treatment、conditions 或 cruelty，用于谴责极度残暴、冷酷无情或非人的环境，语体正式。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of lacking compassion or consideration for others

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inhuman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: showing fear and lack of confidence

examples.en: The timid child hid behind her mother's coat whenever a stranger approached.
examples.zh: 每当有陌生人靠近，那个胆小的孩子就会躲在妈妈的外套后面。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰人、神态或动作，如 timid smile、timid voice，描述缺乏勇气、害羞或胆小的特质。

lemmas.def_zh: 胆怯的, 胆小的, 羞怯的
lemmas.def_en: timid by nature or revealing timidity

examples.en: The timorous kitten peeked out cautiously from behind the heavy velvet curtains.
examples.zh: 那只胆怯的小猫小心翼翼地从厚重的丝绒窗帘后探出头来。

lemmas.def_en: in a shy or timid or bashful manner

examples.en: he smiled shyly

lemmas.def_en: in a timorous and trepid manner

lemmas.def_zh: 胆小, 胆怯, 羞怯
lemmas.def_en: fear of the unknown or unfamiliar or fear of making decisions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 timid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 意义不明确的, 模棱两可的
lemmas.def_en: open to two or more interpretations; or of uncertain nature or significance; or (often) intended to mislead

examples.en: The politician gave an equivocal answer to avoid taking a clear stance on the controversial policy.
examples.zh: 这位政客给出了一个模棱两可的回答，以避免对这项争议性政策表明明确立场。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 statement、response 或 result，指故意含糊其辞或两可不定的结果，反义词为 unequivocal。

lemmas.def_zh: 不含糊的, 不模棱两可的, 明确的
lemmas.def_en: admitting of no doubt or misunderstanding; having only one meaning or interpretation and leading to only one conclusion

examples.en: unequivocal evidence
took an unequivocal position

lemmas.def_zh: 只有一种含意地, 清楚明白地
lemmas.def_en: in an unambiguous manner

examples.en: she stated her intentions unequivocally

lemmas.def_en: in an ambiguous manner

examples.en: this letter is worded ambiguously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 equivocal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a prediction about how something (as the weather) will develop

examples.en: Doctors gave a favorable prognosis after the surgery was completed without complications.
examples.zh: 手术顺利完成且未出现并发症后，医生给出了良好的预后评估。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指疾病的预后，经济上指前景预测，复数形式为 prognoses，常与 good、poor 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 预兆, 预言, 预测
lemmas.def_en: a sign of something about to happen

examples.en: he looked for an omen before going into battle

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes predictions of the future (usually on the basis of special knowledge)
of or relating to prediction; having value for making predictions

examples.en: The physician carefully analyzed several prognostic factors before giving the patient a recovery timeline.
examples.zh: 医生在给出患者康复时间表之前，仔细分析了几个预后因素。

lemmas.def_zh: 预兆, 预言, 预测
lemmas.def_en: make a prediction about; tell in advance

examples.en: Economists attempt to prognosticate market trends using complex mathematical and statistical models.
examples.zh: 经济学家试图利用复杂的数学和统计模型来预测市场趋势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prognosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (colloquial) the application of maximum thrust

examples.en: The company installed an advanced firewall to protect its internal network from unauthorized access.
examples.zh: 公司安装了先进的防火墙，以保护内部网络免受未经授权的访问。

lemmas.usage_note: 计算机网络中指防火墙安全系统，也指建筑中的防火隔墙，常与 configure、breach 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 firewall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: moving toward the east

examples.en: The explorers continued their eastward journey across the vast and barren desert.
examples.zh: 探险家们继续他们向东穿越广袤荒凉沙漠的旅程。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语修饰名词，表示向东的、朝东方向的，常见搭配如 eastward journey、eastward slope。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal compass point that is at 90 degrees

examples.en: They saw a dense bank of dark storm clouds gathering slowly to the eastward.
examples.zh: 他们看到东面正缓缓聚起一团浓厚的乌云风暴。

lemmas.usage_note: 指朝东的方向，通常与定冠词 the 及介词 to 搭配构成 to the eastward，属较正式书面用法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eastward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the theory that the parts of any whole cannot exist and cannot be understood except in their relation to the whole

examples.en: Modern alternative medicine often embraces holism by treating the patient's mind and body together.
examples.zh: 现代替代医学通常奉行整体论，将患者的身心作为一个整体进行治疗。

lemmas.usage_note: 哲学及医学术语，指整体论或整体性观点，强调整体大于部分之和，常与 reductionism 相对。

lemmas.def_en: emphasizing the organic or functional relation between parts and the whole

family_guide.root_logic: 以 holism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 迷宫, 难解事物, 迷路
lemmas.def_en: complex system of paths or tunnels in which it is easy to get lost

examples.en: We soon found ourselves lost in a confusing labyrinth of narrow, winding alleyways.
examples.zh: 我们很快就在狭窄曲折、错综复杂的街巷迷宫中迷了路。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指实体迷宫，也常引申为复杂难解的体系或网络，常搭配 a labyrinth of rules/streets。

lemmas.def_zh: 迷宫的, 难解的, 曲折的
lemmas.def_en: resembling a labyrinth in form or complexity

examples.en: a labyrinthine network of tortuous footpaths

family_guide.root_logic: 以 labyrinth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光辉, 光彩, 光泽
lemmas.def_en: the visual property of something that shines with reflected light

examples.en: The conditioner left her dark hair with a healthy, natural sheen.
examples.zh: 护发素让她的深色秀发泛出一种健康自然的光泽。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词，形容丝绸、毛发、金属或抛光表面散发出的柔和光泽，常与 glossy、silky 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: (ethnic slur) offensive term for a Jew

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sheen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 突然转向, 转弯, 背离；使突然转向, 使转弯, 使背离
lemmas.def_en: turn sharply; change direction abruptly

examples.en: The driver had to swerve sharply to avoid hitting a deer that had dashed into the road.
examples.zh: 司机不得不猛打方向盘急转弯，以避开一只冲到路中间的鹿。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，指车辆或人突然急转弯以避开障碍，后常接介词 to、into 或 from，亦可引申为背离既定原则。

lemmas.def_zh: 不歪的, 不走歪的, 不编离的, 始终不渝的
lemmas.def_en: going directly ahead from one point to another without veering or turning aside

examples.en: some people see evolution as an undeviating upward march from simple organisms to the very complex
a straight and narrow tree-lined road unswerving across the lowlands

lemmas.def_zh: 坚持不懈地, 坚定不移地; 毫不动摇; 坚定不渝
lemmas.def_en: in a constant and steadfast manner

examples.en: an unswervingly loyal man

family_guide.root_logic: 以 swerve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 格言, 箴言, 侏儒, 土地神
lemmas.def_en: a legendary creature resembling a tiny old man; lives in the depths of the earth and guards buried treasure

examples.en: She decorated her flowerbed with a colorful ceramic gnome holding a tiny spade.
examples.zh: 她用一个手拿小铁锹的彩色陶瓷小矮人装饰了自己的花坛。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，主要指神话中的地精、矮人或装饰性花园小矮人（garden gnome）；在文学语境中亦可指格言或箴言。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or containing gnomes

examples.en: gnomic verse

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gnome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short moral story (often with animal characters)

examples.en: George Orwell's novel is widely interpreted as a political allegory about totalitarianism.
examples.zh: 乔治·奥威尔的这部小说被广泛解读为一部关于极权主义的政治寓言。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学术语，指具有象征或劝诫意义的寓言故事，常与 of 连用（an allegory of...），亦可作不可数名词表示讽喻法。

lemmas.def_en: used in or characteristic of or containing allegory

examples.en: allegorical stories
an allegorical painting of Victory leading an army

lemmas.def_en: used in or characteristic of or containing allegory

examples.en: allegorical stories
an allegorical painting of Victory leading an army

lemmas.def_en: in an allegorical manner

examples.en: the play ended allegorically

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allegory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a strong sea boat designed to rescue people from a sinking ship

examples.en: The crew quickly lowered the lifeboat into the churning sea as the ship began to sink.
examples.zh: 随着船只开始下沉，船员们迅速将救生艇降入汹涌的海水中。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与 launch、lower 等动词搭配，指船上配备的救生艇，亦可引申指经济或危机中的救援机制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lifeboat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mill that is powered by the wind

examples.en: The old wooden windmill on the hill has been converted into a charming museum.
examples.zh: 山丘上那座古老的木制风车已被改建为一座迷人的博物馆。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指利用风力研磨或发电的风车，常见搭配如 tilt at windmills（与假想敌搏斗，源自堂吉诃德）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 windmill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: gleam or glow intermittently

examples.en: The grandfather's eyes began to twinkle with amusement as he told the humorous tale.
examples.zh: 祖父讲起那个幽默的故事时，眼里闪烁着笑意。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，主语多为星光、灯火或人的眼睛，形容因喜悦或狡黠而神采飞扬，常与 with 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 闪耀的, 耀眼的, 闪闪发光的; 微笑的；欣喜的
lemmas.def_en: smiling with happiness or optimism; - Lewis Carroll

examples.en: Her grandfather looked down at her with warm, twinkly eyes and smiled softly.
examples.zh: 祖父用温暖而闪烁着笑意的眼睛看着她，温柔地微笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 twinkle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a source of oil; used for forage and soil improvement and as food

examples.en: Farmers in the Midwest grow vast fields of corn and soybeans every summer.
examples.zh: 中西部的农民每年夏天都会大面积种植玉米和大豆。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词（多用复数 soybeans），常作定语修饰 oil、milk 等名词，指大豆这种农作物或其豆粒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soybean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 放纵, 使吃饱, 使过量
lemmas.def_en: treat with excessive indulgence

examples.en: After weeks of exhausting work, she decided to pamper herself with a relaxing day at the spa.
examples.zh: 在连续几周精疲力竭的工作后，她决定去水疗中心享受惬意的一天来犒劳自己。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于 pamper oneself 或 pamper someone with...，表示悉心娇惯、宠溺或提供极度舒适的享受。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pamper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: presumptuously daring

examples.en: The crowd gasped in awe as the motorcyclist performed a daredevil jump over ten buses.
examples.zh: 当摩托车手完成飞跃十辆大巴的不怕死的特技时，人群倒吸了一口凉气。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语，修饰 stunts、pilot 等名词，形容行为大胆冒险、不顾性命安危的狂热状态，具赞赏或警示色彩。

lemmas.def_zh: 铤而走险的人, 蛮勇的人
lemmas.def_en: a reckless impetuous irresponsible person

examples.en: He has been a true daredevil since childhood, always climbing the tallest trees and cliffs.
examples.zh: 他从小就是个彻头彻尾的冒险狂，总是攀爬最高的大树和悬崖。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指喜好铤而走险、追求刺激的亡命之徒或特技表演者，语体轻松，常含褒义或惊叹感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daredevil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 广阔, 充足, 幅度
lemmas.def_en: (physics) the maximum displacement of a periodic wave

examples.en: Engineers adjusted the machine to reduce the amplitude of the mechanical vibrations.
examples.zh: 工程师们调试了机器，以减小机械震动的振幅。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学与工程学专业名词，指波动的振幅；文雅语体中可引申表示规模、范围的广阔或思维的丰富全面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amplitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 践踏, 重步行走, 步行, 流浪；走过, 踩
lemmas.def_en: travel on foot, especially on a walking expedition

examples.en: We tramped through the muddy forest for hours before finding the main road.
examples.zh: 我们在泥泞的森林里艰难跋涉了数小时才找到大路。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指沉重、疲惫或长距离地步行，后接介词 through/across，也可作及物动词表示踩踏。

lemmas.def_en: someone who walks with a heavy noisy gait or who stamps on the ground

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tramp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 前奏, 序幕, 序诗, 前奏曲
lemmas.def_en: something that serves as a preceding event or introduces what follows

examples.en: The peaceful protest was merely a prelude to months of civil unrest.
examples.zh: 这场和平抗议仅仅是数月社会动荡的序幕。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数名词，后接 to 表示某事的序幕或前奏，亦指音乐中的前奏曲，属正式书面语。

lemmas.def_en: serve as a prelude or opening to

examples.en: A brief period of diplomatic tension preluded the outbreak of the war.
examples.zh: 短暂的外交紧张局势拉开了战争爆发的序幕。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，表示作为……的序幕或预兆，语体极为正式，常用于文学或政论语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prelude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hold firmly and tightly

examples.en: She clasped her hands tightly in her lap to stop them from shaking.
examples.zh: 她把双手紧紧扣在膝头，以防它们颤抖。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作及物动词，表示用手紧握或紧紧抱住，常与 hands、to one's chest 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 解开...的扣子, 解开...的钩子；vi. (使)打开, 放开, 松开
lemmas.def_en: release from a clasp

examples.en: She clasped and unclasped her hands

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clasp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚固的, 坚强的, 忠实的, 忠诚的, 不透水的
lemmas.def_en: firm and dependable especially in loyalty

examples.en: Throughout his political career, he remained a staunch defender of free speech.
examples.zh: 在整个政治生涯中，他始终是言论自由坚定的捍卫者。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 supporter、ally 或 defender，表示忠实坚定、不可动摇的，具积极褒义色彩。

lemmas.def_en: in a staunch manner

examples.en: he staunchly defended his principles

family_guide.root_logic: 以 staunch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弄皱, 触怒, 洗(牌), 连续轻擂(鼓)；起皱, 发脾气, 连续轻擂
lemmas.def_en: stir up (water) so as to form ripples

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind ruffled the surface of the calm lake.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的强风吹皱了平静的湖面。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指弄乱羽毛、头发或水面，也常比喻打扰平静，习语 ruffle sb's feathers 意为激怒某人。

lemmas.def_zh: 不起皱的, 不骚动的, 不混乱的, 安定的
lemmas.def_en: free from emotional agitation or nervous tension; ; - Anthony Trollope

examples.en: the waiters were unflurried and good natured
with contented mind and unruffled spirit

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ruffle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 官僚作风的人, 官僚, 官僚主义者
lemmas.def_en: an official of a bureaucracy

examples.en: The project was delayed for months by uncooperative bureaucrats.
examples.zh: 由于不通融的官僚们百般阻挠，该项目被推迟了数月。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指政府或大机构中的行政官员，往往带有墨守成规、办事呆板的贬义色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bureaucrat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: feel about uncertainly or blindly

examples.en: He groped around in the dark for his glasses on the bedside table.
examples.zh: 他在黑暗中摸索着床头柜上的眼镜。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 for 或 around 连用，表示在黑暗中摸索寻找；也可作及物动词，指非礼或乱摸他人身体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 连接, 接线图, 联播
lemmas.def_en: a device providing a connection between a power source and a user

examples.en: The camper van features a full electrical hookup for convenience.
examples.zh: 这辆露营房车配备了完整的电源接口装置，非常方便。

lemmas.usage_note: 指设备、管道的连接装置或网络转播；在现代非正式口语中，常指两人的短暂约会或亲密接触。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hookup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三个一组, 三件一组, 三和音
lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one

examples.en: The medical report described a classic triad of symptoms associated with the disease.
examples.zh: 这份医疗报告描述了与该疾病相关的三大经典临床症状。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指三件一套的事物、音乐中的三和弦；首字母大写时特指华人黑社会犯罪组织。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a speech sound that is not a vowel

examples.en: In English, the word 'strength' ends with a complex cluster of consonants.
examples.zh: 在英语中，单词 strength 以一组复杂的辅音丛结尾。

lemmas.usage_note: 语音学术语，指发音时气流受阻的辅音或字母表中的辅音字母，对应元音 vowel。

lemmas.def_zh: 一致, 调和, 辅音韵
lemmas.def_en: the repetition of consonants (or consonant patterns) especially at the ends of words

examples.en: The architect designed the modern pavilion in perfect consonance with its natural surroundings.
examples.zh: 建筑师设计的现代展馆与周围的自然环境完美协调。

lemmas.def_zh: 辅音的, 带辅音性质的, 辅音一样的
lemmas.def_en: being or marked by or containing or functioning as a consonant

examples.en: consonantal sounds
a consonantal Hebrew text

family_guide.root_logic: 以 consonant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a smith who forges and shapes iron with a hammer and anvil

examples.en: The blacksmith hammered the glowing iron bar into a horseshoe on his anvil.
examples.zh: 铁匠在铁砧上将烧红的铁条锤打成马蹄铁。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指锻造铁器的铁匠，常与forge、anvil搭配使用，多见于历史与传统手工艺语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blacksmith 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 妇女联谊会, 女学生联谊会
lemmas.def_en: a social club for female undergraduates

examples.en: She decided to join a sorority during her freshman year to make lifelong friends.
examples.zh: 她决定在大一期间加入一个女生联谊会，以结交终生挚友。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指北美大学的女生联谊会，常与join、rush、sister搭配，属于校园社交文化词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sorority 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: be or do something to a greater degree

examples.en: The tech company managed to outperform its major rivals in quarterly earnings.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司的季度收益成功超越了其主要竞争对手。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指表现优于或收益超过，常与market、competitor搭配，广泛用于财经与商业语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outperform 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of a proenzyme to an active enzyme

examples.en: Researchers developed a new drug designed to target this specific protein kinase.
examples.zh: 研究人员开发了一种专门针对这种特定蛋白激酶的新药。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物化学专业名词，指催化磷酸基团转移的激酶，常与inhibitor、activation搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kinase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 激动, 感到刺痛, 抖动；使感刺痛
lemmas.def_en: cause a stinging or tingling sensation

examples.en: His fingers began to tingle with warmth as he sat by the roaring fireplace.
examples.zh: 当他坐在熊熊燃烧的壁炉旁时，手指开始感到一阵暖洋洋的刺痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作不及物动词表刺痛或兴奋颤抖，常与with连用；亦可作及物动词表示使感到刺痛。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 刺痛的；发麻的；引起微麻或激动感觉的
lemmas.def_en: causing or experiencing a slight prickling or stinging sensation, often associated with cold, excitement, or numbness
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述身体感官（如手指、皮肤的发麻）或情绪上的悸动与兴奋。

examples.en: She felt a tingling sensation in her fingers as they began to warm up.
examples.zh: 随着手指渐渐回暖，她感到指尖有一阵阵发麻的刺痛感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tingle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雪球, 果味冰霜卷, 滚雪球式的募捐法
lemmas.def_en: plant having heads of fragrant white trumpet-shaped flowers; grows in sandy arid regions

examples.en: The children gathered in the park to throw snowballs at each other after the heavy blizzard.
examples.zh: 大暴雪过后，孩子们聚集在公园里互相扔雪球。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词表示雪球，常用于比喻如snowball effect（滚雪球效应），多在日常及经济语境中出现。

lemmas.def_zh: 向...丢雪球, 使滚雪球般增长；打雪仗, 滚雪球般增长
lemmas.def_en: increase or accumulate at a rapidly accelerating rate

examples.en: What started as a minor clerical error quickly snowballed into a major financial crisis.
examples.zh: 起初只是一点小小的文书失误，很快就滚雪球般演变成了一场重大的财务危机。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词常作不及物用，指像滚雪球般迅速扩大或恶化，常与into搭配，多用于问题或债务累积。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snowball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cotton knit pullover with long sleeves worn during athletic activity

examples.en: He pulled on a warm fleece sweatshirt before heading out into the chilly morning air.
examples.zh: 他在走向清晨寒冷的室外之前穿上了一件保暖的抓绒长袖运动衫。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指休闲或运动穿的长袖厚运动衫（常为棉质套头衫），常与hoodie辨析，属于日常服装词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sweatshirt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: owing gratitude or recognition to another for help or favors etc

examples.en: I am deeply indebted to my mentor for her invaluable guidance throughout my research career.
examples.zh: 我对我导师在我科研生涯中给予的宝贵指导深表感激。

lemmas.usage_note: 作表语形容词，常构成be indebted to sb for sth结构，既可指经济上负债，更常指感激不尽（正式语体）。

lemmas.def_en: an obligation to pay money to another party

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indebted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the heart and its diseases

examples.en: Advances in cardiology have significantly improved the survival rates of heart failure patients.
examples.zh: 心脏病学的发展显著提高了心力衰竭患者的生存率。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，医学专业术语，指心脏病学，常见搭配如department of cardiology（心脏科）。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in cardiology; a specialist in the structure and function and disorders of the heart

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cardiology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: supreme military leader exercising civil power in a region especially one accountable to nobody when the central government is weak

examples.en: The central government struggled to assert control over territories ruled by powerful warlords.
examples.zh: 中央政府竭尽全力试图对强权军阀割据的地区确立控制权。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指割据一方的军阀或地方武装首领，常用于历史、政治及地缘冲突语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 warlord 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a composition for orchestra and a soloist

examples.en: She performed a breathtaking rendition of Beethoven's violin concerto with the orchestra.
examples.zh: 她与管弦乐队合作，惊艳地演奏了贝多芬的小提琴协奏曲。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指由独奏乐器与管弦乐队协同演奏的古典乐曲，常接 for 引导独奏乐器，复数可用 concertos 或 concerti。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 concerto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: Norwegian painter (1863-1944)

examples.en: I usually keep some nuts in my desk drawer for a quick munch during breaks.
examples.zh: 我通常在书桌抽屉里放些坚果，以便课间休息时吃点零嘴。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语中指轻松简单的便餐、吃零食的行为或供咀嚼的零食，常用于 have a munch 等短语。

lemmas.def_en: a chewer who makes a munching noise

lemmas.def_zh: 用力咀嚼, 大声咀嚼
lemmas.def_en: chew noisily

examples.en: He sat on the couch, munching on buttered popcorn while watching the match.
examples.zh: 他坐在沙发上，一边看比赛一边嚼着黄油爆米花。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示津津有味、咯吱咯吱地大声咀嚼食物，常与介词 on 或 away 搭配，多用于非正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 munch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: braying characteristic of donkeys

examples.en: A donkey brayed loudly outside the barn, waking up the entire farm.
examples.zh: 一头驴在谷仓外大声嘶叫，吵醒了整个农场的人。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指驴子发出刺耳的嘶叫，也常比喻人发出高声尖锐、刺耳难听的笑声或说话声，属文学或贬义语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bray 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of questionable or minimal quality

examples.en: His exam score was a borderline pass, requiring further review by the committee.
examples.zh: 他的考试成绩勉强达到及格线，需要评审委员会作进一步审核。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指地理上的边界，更常用于比喻接近临界点、模棱两可或勉强及格的状态，作定语或表语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 borderline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the acetylated derivative of salicylic acid; used as an analgesic anti-inflammatory drug (trade names Bayer, Empirin, and St. Joseph) usually taken in tablet form; used as an antipyretic; slows clotting of the blood by poisoning platelets

examples.en: The doctor advised him to take an aspirin daily to reduce the risk of a heart attack.
examples.zh: 医生建议他每天服用一片阿司匹林，以降低心脏病发作的风险。

lemmas.usage_note: 指常见的解热镇痛药阿司匹林，通常作不可数名词，但在指代“一片药丸”时可用 an aspirin。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aspirin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in or toward the northern parts of a state

examples.en: They decided to move upstate after living in New York City for more than a decade.
examples.zh: 在纽约市生活了十多年后，他们决定搬到该州北部定居。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要在美式英语中使用，指朝向或在某个州（尤其是远离大都市的北部偏远或乡村地区）的方向移动或存在。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upstate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of providing an item for general use or for official purposes (usually in quantity)

examples.en: The strict regulations delayed the issuance of new business permits for several weeks.
examples.zh: 严格的规章制度导致新营业执照的签发被推迟了数周。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式行政或法律用语，特指官方文件、执照、护照、债券或法令的正式签发、发行行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 issuance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 认识, 认识力, 认识的结果
lemmas.def_en: the psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning

examples.en: Research indicates that regular physical exercise can significantly improve human cognition in old age.
examples.zh: 研究表明，规律的体育锻炼能够显著改善老年时期的认知能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 心理学与哲学学术术语，指通过思维、经验和感知获取知识与理解的认知心理过程，通常不可数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cognition 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: between or among stars

examples.en: Scientists are developing advanced robotic probes capable of long-duration interstellar travel.
examples.zh: 科学家们正在研发有能力执行长期星际航行任务的先进机器人探测器。

lemmas.usage_note: 天文学及科幻语境中的专用词，指发生在恒星与恒星之间极其广袤的空间，仅作前置定语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interstellar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 区分的, 制造分裂的, 造成不和的
lemmas.def_en: dissenting (especially dissenting with the majority opinion)

examples.en: The politician's divisive rhetoric alienated moderate voters and deepened the political crisis.
examples.zh: 这位政客制造分裂的言论疏远了温和派选民，并加深了政治危机。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰言论、政策、议题或领导人，形容容易引发激烈争论、促成阵营对立或撕裂群体的特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 divisive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a health facility where patients receive treatment

examples.en: The injured student was immediately sent to the school infirmary for basic treatment.
examples.zh: 受伤的学生立刻被送往学校医务室接受基础救治。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指学校、军营、监狱或修道院内部附属的医务室或病房，亦可用于部分老式医院名称。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infirmary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a very dark black

examples.en: The antique cabinet was crafted from solid ebony and inlaid with mother-of-pearl.
examples.zh: 这个古董柜由实心乌木打造，并镶嵌着珍珠母贝。

lemmas.usage_note: 指产于热带的乌木质料，常与质感坚硬、贵重家具或乐器制造相关联，属于不可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ebony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 枪的表尺, 事后聪明
lemmas.def_en: understanding the nature of an event after it has happened

examples.en: With hindsight, we should have consulted an expert before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 事后看来，我们在签合同之前本应该咨询专家的。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于固定搭配 in hindsight（事后看来）或 with hindsight，属于不可数书面语名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hindsight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 对同性恋的憎恶（或恐惧）
lemmas.def_en: prejudice against (fear or dislike of) homosexual people and homosexuality

examples.en: The campaign aims to raise awareness and eliminate homophobia in high schools.
examples.zh: 该活动旨在提高认知度，并在高中校园内消除对同性恋的排斥与偏见。

lemmas.usage_note: 指对同性恋者的非理性恐惧或偏见，为不可数名词，常见搭配有 combat/tackle homophobia。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homophobia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 圆柱体的, 圆筒形的
lemmas.def_en: having the form of a cylinder

examples.en: The factory produces cylindrical metal containers for storing industrial chemicals.
examples.zh: 该工厂生产用于储存工业化学品的圆柱形金属容器。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于描述物体呈圆柱或圆筒形状，属于客观几何特征形容词，常见搭配如 cylindrical shape/tube。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cylindrical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 上诉的, 有权受理上诉的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or taking account of appeals (usually legal appeals)

examples.en: The appellate court overturned the previous ruling due to insufficient evidence.
examples.zh: 上诉法院因证据不足推翻了此前的判决。

lemmas.usage_note: 仅用于法律公文语境，主要作定语，固定搭配包括 appellate court（上诉法院）及 appellate jurisdiction。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appellate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: indicating the most important performer or role

examples.en: She trained tirelessly for years to become the prima ballerina of the company.
examples.zh: 她不知疲倦地训练了多年，终于成为了舞团的首席芭蕾舞演员。

lemmas.usage_note: 借自意大利语，多构成固定短语作定语，如 prima ballerina（首席芭蕾舞女演员）或法律用语 prima facie。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prima 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平民, 大众, 人口
lemmas.def_en: people in general considered as a whole

examples.en: The government struggled to communicate the new health policies to the general populace.
examples.zh: 政府竭力向普通大众传达这些新的卫生政策。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常加定冠词 the populace，指某国家或地区的平民大众，带有政论或较严肃的书面语体色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 populace 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 吹毛求疵的, 挑剔的, 找麻烦的
lemmas.def_en: exacting especially about details

examples.en: My younger brother is extremely picky about what he eats and dislikes all vegetables.
examples.zh: 我弟弟吃东西极其挑剔，讨厌所有的蔬菜。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用形容词，多形容在饮食、选择等细节上吹毛求疵，常搭配介词 about，如 be picky about food。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 picky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large primitive fishes valued for their flesh and roe; widely distributed in the North Temperate Zone

examples.en: Overfishing has posed a serious threat to the wild sturgeon population in the river.
examples.zh: 过度捕捞对该河流中野生鲟鱼的种群生存构成了严重威胁。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指产鱼子酱的名贵大型淡水/咸水鲟鱼，复数形式常为 sturgeon 或 sturgeons。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sturgeon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 引起幻觉的, 荧光的
lemmas.def_en: producing distorted sensory perceptions and feelings or altered states of awareness or sometimes states resembling psychosis

examples.en: The album cover features swirling, psychedelic patterns of bright purple and neon green.
examples.zh: 专辑封面采用了亮紫色与荧光绿交织的旋转迷幻图案。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 drugs、music、art 或 patterns，既指致幻效果，也指色彩鲜艳迷幻的视觉风格。

lemmas.def_en: the subculture of users of psychedelic drugs

examples.en: The rock band's album featured vibrant cover art influenced by late sixties psychedelia.
examples.zh: 这支摇滚乐队的专辑封面采用了受六十年代末迷幻艺术影响的鲜艳设计。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 psychedelic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: widely cultivated as a groundcover for its dark green shiny leaves and usually blue-violet flowers

examples.en: The garden was enclosed by a fragrant hedge of sweet-smelling myrtle.
examples.zh: 花园被一圈散发着甜香的桃金娘绿篱所环绕。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指桃金娘科常绿灌木，常用作可数或不可数名词，常见搭配包括 crepe myrtle（紫薇）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myrtle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: partial or total loss of memory

examples.en: After surviving the head injury, the patient suffered from temporary retrograde amnesia.
examples.zh: 头部受伤幸存后，该患者遭受了暂时的逆行性遗忘症。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学及日常通用名词，常与 suffer from、cause 或 retrograde 搭配，多作不可数名词使用。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by amnesia

examples.en: The head injury left him temporarily amnesic about the events of that night.
examples.zh: 头部受伤使他暂时遗忘了那天晚上发生的事情。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by amnesia

examples.en: The patient experienced an amnestic episode following the severe head injury sustained yesterday.
examples.zh: 在昨天遭受严重的头部创伤后，该患者出现了一次健忘发作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amnesia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears: widely cultivated in America in many varieties; the principal cereal in Mexico and Central and South America since pre-Columbian times

examples.en: Maize is a staple crop that supports rural livelihoods across many African nations.
examples.zh: 玉蜀黍是许多非洲国家维系农村生计的主要粮食作物。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词时主要在英式及农业语境中指玉米（不可数），美式多称 corn；亦可作定语表示鲜黄色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 成酸的, 尖刻的, 酸性的
lemmas.def_en: being or containing an acid; of a solution having an excess of hydrogen atoms (having a pH of less than 7)

examples.en: Azaleas thrive best when planted in slightly acidic, well-drained soil.
examples.zh: 杜鹃花在微酸性且排水良好的土壤中生长得最旺盛。

lemmas.usage_note: 可修饰土壤、水质等化学性质（与 alkaline 相对），也可引申修饰言语、评论的尖刻刺人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acidic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [动] 鳞龟属(=Lepidochelys)动物 (产于墨西哥湾)
lemmas.def_en: a marine turtle

examples.en: Conservationists worked overnight to protect the nesting grounds of the endangered olive ridley.
examples.zh: 环保人士整夜守护，以保护濒危太平洋丽龟的筑巢地。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，生物学术语，极高频出现在 Kemp's ridley 或 olive ridley（丽龟属海龟）固定命名中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ridley 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an examination conducted by spoken communication

examples.en: She spent weeks preparing for her PhD viva by anticipating every difficult question.
examples.zh: 她通过预想每一个棘手问题，为博士毕业口试准备了数周。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于英联邦学术语境（源自 viva voce），指博士等高等学位的毕业论文口试，常作可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viva 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使商业化, 使商品化, 使能营利, 在...发展商业
lemmas.def_en: exploit for maximal profit, usually by sacrificing quality

examples.en: The university partnered with a tech firm to commercialize its patented battery design.
examples.zh: 该大学与一家科技公司合作，将其获得专利的电池设计进行商业化运作。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，宾语常为 technology、research 或 traditional holiday，有时带有过度商业化的贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_en: the act of commercializing something; involving something in commerce

examples.en: my father considered the commercialization of Christmas to be a sacrilege
the government tried to accelerate the commercialization of this development

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commercialize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扫, 拂, 挥动, 迅速移动, 搅拌；飞奔
lemmas.def_en: move somewhere quickly

examples.en: Whisk the egg whites vigorously until stiff peaks form on the surface.
examples.zh: 用力搅打蛋白，直到表面形成挺立的尖角。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，既指烹饪中用打蛋器快速搅拌（whisk eggs），也指迅速带走或移开（whisk away/off）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whisk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the two male reproductive glands that produce spermatozoa and secrete androgens

examples.en: Regular self-examination helps in the early detection of abnormalities in the testicle.
examples.zh: 定期的自我检查有助于早期发现睾丸内的异常病变。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学可数名词，文雅医学语体，常以复数形式出现，通俗口语中多被 balls 或 testes 替代。

lemmas.def_en: of or involving the testes

examples.en: Regular checkups can help detect testicular cancer at an early, curable stage.
examples.zh: 定期体检有助于在早期可治愈阶段发现睾丸癌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 testicle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 接合, 捻接, 胶接, 使结婚
lemmas.def_en: join the ends of

examples.en: The editors worked through the night to splice the newly recorded scenes into the documentary.
examples.zh: 剪辑师们通宵达旦地将新录制的场景剪接拼入纪录片中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指通过机械、物理或生物学手段将两段物体（如绳缆、胶片、基因）拼接为一体，常与 together 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 接合东西的人, 连接工具
lemmas.def_en: a woodworker who joins pieces of wood with a splice

family_guide.root_logic: 以 splice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可信任的, 可靠的, 可信赖的
lemmas.def_en: worthy of reliance or trust

examples.en: She proved to be a highly dependable assistant during the company's financial crisis.
examples.zh: 事实证明，在公司遭遇财务危机期间，她是一位非常值得信赖的助手。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于修饰人、设备或信息来源，强调值得信赖且表现始终如一，常作定语或表语使用。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可靠的, 靠不住的, 不可信赖的
lemmas.def_en: not worthy of reliance or trust

examples.en: in the early 1950s computers were large and expensive and unreliable
an undependable assistant

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being dependable or reliable

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dependable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make a sound like frying fat

examples.en: Thick slices of bacon began to sizzle noisily in the hot frying pan.
examples.zh: 厚厚的培根片在滚烫的煎锅里开始嗞嗞作响。

lemmas.usage_note: 拟声动词，描写食物油煎、烧烤时发出的吱吱作响声，亦可引申形容天气酷热或气氛火爆。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 滚烫的，灼热的；极其热烈的，性感的
lemmas.def_en: very hot; passionate or exciting
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指物理上的极度炎热（如 sizzling heat），也可形容极具吸引力或激烈的氛围、表演等。

examples.en: The two actors displayed sizzling chemistry on screen.
examples.zh: 这两位演员在银幕上展现出了极为火热的默契。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sizzle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 热心的, 激动的, 燃烧般的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by intense emotion

examples.en: As an ardent advocate for environmental protection, she organized several community clean-up campaigns.
examples.zh: 作为环保事业的热忱倡导者，她组织了数次社区清洁活动。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语色彩浓厚，常用于修饰支持者、追求者或情感，表达极其热烈、坚定不移的投入状态。

lemmas.def_en: in an ardent manner

examples.en: the spirit of God knew very well that there was a deeper question to be settled before there could be the intervention in power that was so ardently desired

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ardent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: vi. 降低...的价值, 贬值, 降低价值, 使(货币)贬值
lemmas.def_en: remove the value from; deprive of its value

examples.en: The central bank decided to devalue the national currency by five percent to stimulate exports.
examples.zh: 央行决定将本国货币贬值5%，以刺激出口增长。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于金融经济语境指货币官方贬值，亦可用于抽象语境表示贬低、低估某事物的价值或重要性。

lemmas.def_en: an official lowering of a nation's currency; a decrease in the value of a country's currency relative to that of foreign countries

family_guide.root_logic: 以 devalue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cream spread on the skin; contains a chemical (as PABA) to filter out ultraviolet light and so protect from sunburn

examples.en: You should apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen at least twenty minutes before going out in the sun.
examples.zh: 在去户外晒太阳前，你应至少提前二十分钟涂抹广谱防晒霜。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不可数名词使用，特指防晒乳液或霜剂，常与动词 apply, put on, wear 构成高频搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunscreen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 废止, 使无效, 取消, 撤消, 解除
lemmas.def_en: cancel officially

examples.en: The university committee voted unanimously to rescind the controversial policy.
examples.zh: 大学委员会全票通过决议，撤销了那项备受争议的政策。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律与官方用语，常及物接 law, order, contract, offer 等宾语，表示彻底撤销或宣告无效。

lemmas.def_zh: 废止, 取消, 使无效, 撤消
lemmas.def_en: (law) the act of rescinding; the cancellation of a contract and the return of the parties to the positions they would have had if the contract had not been made

examples.en: recission may be brought about by decree or by mutual consent

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rescind 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 捉住, 逮捕, 抢夺
lemmas.def_en: tag the base runner to get him out

examples.en: Undercover officers managed to nab the pickpocket just as he snatched the tourist's wallet.
examples.zh: 便衣警察在那名扒手刚抢走游客钱包的瞬间将其当场抓获。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语与新闻标题常见词，多指警方当场逮住抓获罪犯，或非正式地顺手夺取抢占物品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nab 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 预先排除, 预防, 阻止, 妨碍
lemmas.def_en: keep from happening or arising; make impossible

examples.en: His chronic back injury unfortunately precluded him from participating in the championship game.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，他的慢性背伤使他无法参加锦标赛的决赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语动词，常搭配 preclude somebody from doing something，意为预先阻碍或使某事不可能发生。

lemmas.def_zh: 预防, 消除, 排除, 阻止, 妨碍
lemmas.def_en: the act of preventing something by anticipating and disposing of it effectively

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preclude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

examples.en: The network was heavily fined after broadcasting an indecent joke during the prime-time show.
examples.zh: 该电视台因在黄金时段节目中播出不雅笑话而被处以重罚。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰行为、着装或语言，强调违背公序良俗或令人反感；亦可引申表示不合宜的过快过急。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being indecent

lemmas.def_zh: 下流, 举止粗鄙, 不体面, 猥亵, (非正式)不适当, 不合适
lemmas.def_en: in an indecent manner

examples.en: she was rather indecently dressed

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indecent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a group of many islands in a large body of water

examples.en: The remote archipelago is home to thousands of rare seabirds and unique marine species.
examples.zh: 这座偏远的群岛是数以千计的珍稀海鸟与独特海洋生物的家园。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指‘群岛’，多以单数形式与定冠词连用（the ... archipelago），后常接 of 引导的修饰语，具地理学色彩。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or part of an archipelago

examples.en: an archipelagic war

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archipelago 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a collection of papers containing detailed information about a particular person or subject (usually a person's record)

examples.en: Investigators compiled a comprehensive dossier detailing the suspect's financial transactions.
examples.zh: 调查人员整理了一份详尽的卷宗，详细记录了该嫌疑人的财务交易。

lemmas.usage_note: 指针对某人或某事件整理的‘全套档案卷宗’，常与 compile、assemble、open 等动词搭配，常见于政治或调查语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dossier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a style of handwriting with the letters slanting to the right

examples.en: The book titles in the bibliography should be printed in italics rather than underlined.
examples.zh: 参考书目中的书名应当用斜体印刷，而不是加下划线。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词时多以复数形式 italics 出现，指‘斜体字’；常与介词 in 搭配（in italics），表示‘用斜体印刷’。

lemmas.def_zh: 用斜体字排字, 在字下划横线
lemmas.def_en: print in italics

family_guide.root_logic: 以 italic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: choose by or as if by divine intervention

examples.en: The retiring CEO appeared to anoint the young director as his rightful successor.
examples.zh: 这位即将退休的首席执行官似乎钦定了这位年轻的总监作为自己的合法接班人。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教上指‘涂油祈福’；引申指官方‘钦定、选定接班人’，常接名词或搭配 anoint ... as ...，语体庄重正式。

lemmas.def_en: the act of applying oil or an oily liquid

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anoint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt of hydrofluoric acid

examples.en: Many municipalities add fluoride to drinking water to help reduce tooth decay among children.
examples.zh: 许多市政当局在饮用水中添加氟化物，以帮助减少儿童蛀牙。

lemmas.usage_note: 指化学物质‘氟化物’，为不可数名词；常见于公共卫生与日化领域，常与 toothpaste、water 等词连用构成复合词或修饰。

lemmas.def_en: the addition of a fluoride to the water supply (to prevent dental decay)

lemmas.def_zh: 在饮水中加少量之氟(以防儿童蛀牙)
lemmas.def_en: subject to fluoridation; treat with fluoride

examples.en: fluoridized water
fluoridize the teeth of children

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fluoride 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a midday meal

examples.en: The ambassador hosted an official luncheon to welcome the visiting delegates.
examples.zh: 大使举办了正式午宴，以欢迎来访的代表团。

lemmas.usage_note: 指正式的‘午宴、午餐会’，比 lunch 更庄重，常与 host、attend 搭配，常见于商务社交或慈善筹款活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luncheon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赶超崇拜者, 赶超崇拜者的人
lemmas.def_en: an ambitious and aspiring young person

examples.en: The talent audition was crowded with rock-star wannabes hoping for their big break.
examples.zh: 选秀现场挤满了梦想成为摇滚巨星的模仿者，期盼着能一举成名。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语用词，常带轻蔑或戏谑色彩，指‘盲目模仿者、一心想出名的人’；常前置职业名词如 pop star wannabe。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wannabe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装入胶囊, 封进内部, 压缩；做成胶囊
lemmas.def_en: enclose in a capsule or other small container

examples.en: His final documentary seemed to encapsulate the disillusionment of an entire generation.
examples.zh: 他的最后一部纪录片似乎浓缩并体现了整整一代人的幻灭感。

lemmas.usage_note: 比喻义指‘概括、浓缩’（思想或特征），也指物理上的‘封入胶囊内’；常用于学术写作与正式评论中，及物动词。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 封闭, 封装, 密封, 灌封, 装箧
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being enclosed (as in a capsule)

examples.en: the encapsulation of tendons in membranous sheaths

family_guide.root_logic: 以 encapsulate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the four competitions in an elimination tournament whose winners go on to play in the semifinals

examples.en: The national team managed to advance to the quarterfinal after a hard-fought victory.
examples.zh: 国家队在经历了一场艰苦的胜利后，成功晋级四分之一决赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 体育用语，常作复数 quarterfinals 指‘四分之一决赛轮次’；常与 reach、advance to、qualify for 等动词连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quarterfinal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 讽刺文, 戏文, 小喜剧
lemmas.def_en: a short theatrical episode

examples.en: The comedy troupe performed a hilarious skit satirizing recent election debates.
examples.zh: 这个喜剧剧团表演了一出极其搞笑的小品，讽刺最近的选举辩论。

lemmas.usage_note: 指舞台或电视上的‘短剧、幽默滑稽小品’，常含讽刺意味；常与 perform、write 搭配，后常接介词 on/about。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: have a daydream; indulge in a fantasy

examples.en: She sat by the window, daydreaming about traveling around the world.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边，做着环游世界的白日梦。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，后接介词 about 表示对某事的幻想，多用于口语与文学语境。

lemmas.def_en: someone who indulges in idle or absentminded daydreaming

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daydream 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 照耀, 启发, 使灿烂, 放射；发光, 变灿烂
lemmas.def_en: give spiritual insight to; in religion

examples.en: A sudden smile irradiated her face when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 听到这个好消息，她的脸上绽放出了灿烂的笑容。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指用辐射照射处理（科技），也可作比喻表示照亮或容光焕发（文学），及物为主。

lemmas.def_zh: 发光, 光线, 照射
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being exposed to radiation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 irradiate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小贩的同伙, 赌棍的党羽
lemmas.def_en: a decoy who acts as an enthusiastic customer in order to stimulate the participation of others

examples.en: The man bidding aggressively turned out to be a shill hired by the auctioneer.
examples.zh: 那个疯狂竞价的男人原来是拍卖师雇来的托儿。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式名词，指假装顾客以诱导他人上当的托儿或骗子同伙，多含贬义色彩。

lemmas.def_en: act as a shill

examples.en: The influencer was accused of shilling for an unregistered crypto exchange.
examples.zh: 这位网红被指控为一家未注册的加密货币交易所充当托儿。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物或及物动词，常与 for 连用表示为不良产品或骗局充当托儿做宣传，属非正式语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mixture of two partially miscible liquids A and B produces two conjugate solutions: one of A in B and another of B in A

examples.en: The professor asked the students to identify the conjugate in the given sentence.
examples.zh: 教授让学生找出给定句子中的同根词。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术名词，在语法学中指同源词，在数学或化学中指共轭物，属专业术语。

lemmas.def_zh: 结合, 配合, 动词的词形变化
lemmas.def_en: the state of being joined together

lemmas.def_zh: 结合, 配合, 使成对；结合, 结亲
lemmas.def_en: unite chemically so that the product is easily broken down into the original compounds

examples.en: In biology class, we observed how two single cells conjugate to exchange genetic material.
examples.zh: 在生物课上，我们观察了两个单细胞如何结合以交换遗传物质。

lemmas.usage_note: 语法中表示动词词形变化；生物或化学中指结合、配对，兼具及物与不及物用法。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 【化/生】结合的，共轭的；【语】成对的
lemmas.def_en: chemically or biologically joined together; coupled or paired
lemmas.usage_note: 主要作为化学、生物学或医学领域的专业术语，如 conjugated protein（结合蛋白）、conjugated linoleic acid（共轭亚油酸）。

examples.en: Conjugated antibodies are widely used in targeted cancer therapies.
examples.zh: 偶联抗体被广泛应用于癌症靶向治疗中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conjugate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 首饰盒, 小箱, 匣子, 棺材
lemmas.def_en: box in which a corpse is buried or cremated

examples.en: The mourners walked slowly behind the casket draped in the national flag.
examples.zh: 哀悼者缓缓走在覆盖着国旗的棺木后面。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，美语中多指棺材，在传统英式英语中常指贵重的小匣子或首饰盒。

lemmas.def_en: enclose in a casket

examples.en: They casketed the ancient relics carefully to protect them from moisture.
examples.zh: 他们小心翼翼地把古文物装进匣子里，以防受潮。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见及物动词，意为将某物放入小匣或棺内装殓，多见于诗歌或文学书面语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 casket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a prince or king in India

examples.en: The wealthy raja built a magnificent palace for his royal family.
examples.zh: 那位富有的印度王公为自己的王室建造了一座宏伟的宫殿。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史与文化专有名词，指印度的君主或王公，首字母可大写用作头衔称谓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 raja 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 懒人, 潜鸟, 笨蛋
lemmas.def_en: a worthless lazy fellow

examples.en: Pay no attention to him; he's acting like an absolute loon today.
examples.zh: 别理他，他今天表现得像个彻头彻尾的疯子。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指鸟类潜鸟；在北美俚语中常指疯子、怪人或笨蛋，常作贬义评价。

lemmas.def_en: someone deranged and possibly dangerous

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: become unstable

examples.en: Sudden interest rate hikes could destabilize the fragile financial market.
examples.zh: 突然加息可能会破坏脆弱的金融市场的稳定性。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 economy, government, region 搭配，指破坏政治或经济稳定。

lemmas.def_en: become unstable

examples.en: The economy destabilized rapidly

lemmas.def_en: an event that causes a loss of equilibrium (as of a ship or aircraft)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 destabilize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宣告...无罪, 赦免, 免除
lemmas.def_en: grant remission of a sin to

examples.en: The new evidence completely absolved the suspect of any responsibility for the crime.
examples.zh: 新证据完全免除了该嫌疑人对这起犯罪的任何责任。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，核心搭配为 absolve sb from/of sth，多用于正式的法律、道德或宗教语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 免罪, 赦免, 免除
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being formally forgiven by a priest in the sacrament of penance
someone who grants absolution

family_guide.root_logic: 以 absolve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: force to go away; used both with concrete and metaphoric meanings

examples.en: The manager held a meeting to dispel rumors about imminent layoffs.
examples.zh: 经理召开会议以消除关于即将裁员的谣言。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面及物动词，常与 doubts, fears, rumors, myths 等抽象名词搭配，意为消除、打消。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dispel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 群射, 齐发, 迸发
lemmas.def_en: rapid simultaneous discharge of firearms

examples.en: The spokesperson was met with a volley of angry questions from reporters.
examples.zh: 发言人遭到了记者们接二连三的愤怒质问。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于战争或比喻义，搭配 a volley of arrows/questions，指子弹、质问等如雨点般齐发。

lemmas.def_zh: 群射, 齐发, 截击；进行群射, 齐鸣
lemmas.def_en: be dispersed in a volley

examples.en: The striker volleyed the ball into the top corner of the net.
examples.zh: 前锋凌空抽射，将球打入球门上角。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，球类运动中指“凌空截击”，文学语境中可表示“齐射”或“迸发”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 volley 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 违反, 犯罪, 侵犯；越界, 违法
lemmas.def_en: act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises

examples.en: His actions clearly transgressed the accepted norms of professional conduct.
examples.zh: 他的行为显然逾越了职业行为公认的准则。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面正式用词，既可作及物动词接 boundaries/laws，也可作不及物动词接 against，意为违背越轨。

lemmas.def_en: the act of transgressing; the violation of a law or a duty or moral principle

examples.en: the boy was punished for the transgressions of his father

lemmas.def_zh: 违反者, 犯规者, 罪人
lemmas.def_en: someone who transgresses; someone who violates a law or command

examples.en: the way of transgressors is hard

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transgress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a northern direction

examples.en: Migrating birds usually fly northward as spring approaches.
examples.zh: 随着春天的临近，候鸟通常向北飞徙。

lemmas.usage_note: 作副词时常与 head, travel, flow 等动词连用，表示朝北方向运动，亦可写作 northwards。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal compass point that is at 0 or 360 degrees

examples.en: The explorers set their compasses and journeyed into the snowy northward.
examples.zh: 探险家们校准指南针，启程前往白雪皑皑的北方。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词时较少见，通常与介词 to 或 in 构成介词短语 the northward，指“北方地区或方位”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 northward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: postpone doing what one should be doing

examples.en: Most students tend to procrastinate until the night before the deadline.
examples.zh: 大多数学生往往会一直拖延到截止日期的前一天晚上。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，多作不及物动词，后接介词 on/over 表示对某事拖延，也可直接单独使用强调习惯性拖延。

lemmas.def_zh: 拖延, 因循, 耽搁
lemmas.def_en: the act of procrastinating; putting off or delaying or defering an action to a later time
someone who postpones work (especially out of laziness or habitual carelessness)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 procrastinate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wharf usually built parallel to the shoreline

examples.en: A fishing boat was tied securely to the concrete quay.
examples.zh: 一艘渔船被牢牢地系在混凝土码头上。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常与 along, at 或 onto 搭配，指沿岸停靠船只以供装卸货物的石砌码头，发音与 key 相同。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or tending toward fundamentalism

examples.en: The politician's fundamentalist views alienated many moderate voters.
examples.zh: 这位政客的原教旨主义观点使许多温和派选民与他疏远。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语修饰 views, beliefs, regimes 等，指原教旨主义的、固守教条的，常含警示或批评语体色彩。

lemmas.def_en: a supporter of fundamentalism

examples.en: Fundamentalists in the group strongly opposed any reform of the traditional rules.
examples.zh: 该团体中的原教旨主义者强烈反对对传统规则进行任何改革。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指宗教、政治或理念上的原教旨主义者、教条信奉者，常作句子主语或宾语。

lemmas.def_en: the interpretation of every word in the sacred texts as literal truth

examples.en: The rise of religious fundamentalism has threatened progressive social reforms in the region.
examples.zh: 宗教基要主义的兴起威胁到了该地区进步的社会改革。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fundamentalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难得到的, 难接近的, 难达成的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being reached only with great difficulty or not at all

examples.en: The remote mountain village becomes entirely inaccessible by road during the winter.
examples.zh: 这座偏远的山村在冬季完全无法通过公路抵达。

lemmas.usage_note: 作表语或定语，常与 to 搭配（如 inaccessible to beginners），表示地方难以抵达或语言深奥难懂。

lemmas.def_zh: 难达到, 难接近, 难达成
lemmas.def_en: the quality of not being available when needed

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inaccessible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 环绕, 围绕, 包围
lemmas.def_en: form a circle around

examples.en: Tall stone walls encircled the ancient city to protect it from invaders.
examples.zh: 高大的石墙环绕着这座古城，以保护它免受侵略者的侵扰。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态 be encircled by/with，表示在地理或战略上将某物环绕或包围。

lemmas.def_zh: 环绕, 围绕, 包围
lemmas.def_en: a war measure that isolates some area of importance to the enemy

family_guide.root_logic: 以 encircle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蟒蛇, 女用围巾, 羽毛围巾
lemmas.def_en: a long thin fluffy scarf of feathers or fur

examples.en: The singer walked onto the stage wearing an extravagant pink feather boa.
examples.zh: 歌手披着一条奢华的粉色羽毛长围巾走上了舞台。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既指生物学上的蟒蛇（如 boa constrictor），也指时尚语境中的女用羽毛长围巾（feather boa）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 温和的, 适度的, 有节制的, 温带的
lemmas.def_en: (of weather or climate) free from extremes; mild; or characteristic of such weather or climate

examples.en: The country enjoys a temperate climate with mild winters and warm summers.
examples.zh: 该国拥有冬暖夏凉的温带气候。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语常修饰 climate/zone 表示温带；修饰人或行为时作表语或定语，意为克制的、心平气和的。

lemmas.def_en: with restraint

examples.en: he used the privileges of his office temperately

family_guide.root_logic: 以 temperate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 芽, 无性芽, 芽体
lemmas.def_en: small asexual reproductive structure in e.g. liverworts and mosses that detaches from the parent and develops into a new individual

examples.en: In liverworts, each gemma can detach and develop into an entirely new plant.
examples.zh: 在苔类植物中，每一个无性芽都能脱落并长成一株全新的植株。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学专业术语，指苔藓等植物的无性芽或水螅的芽体，常用于植物形态学描述。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gemma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: attend a dance or a party without a female companion

examples.en: Since his girlfriend was out of town, he decided to stag at the prom.
examples.zh: 由于女友出城了，他决定独自一人去参加毕业舞会。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式社交口语，指男子独自或不带女性伴侣出席聚会，多用作不及物动词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: distorted and unnatural in shape or size; abnormal and hideous

examples.en: The old stone gargoyles on the cathedral roof had twisted, grotesque expressions.
examples.zh: 大教堂屋顶上的老石滴水兽带着扭曲而怪诞的表情。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰面容、形象、扭曲的事物或荒唐的情形，带有强烈视觉反差或讽刺色彩。

lemmas.def_en: in a grotesque manner

examples.en: behind the house lay two nude figures grotesquely bald, with deliberate knife-slashes marking their bodies

lemmas.def_en: ludicrous or incongruous unnaturalness or distortion

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grotesque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脸上发红, 发热的, 潮热的, 肺病的
lemmas.def_en: marked by intense agitation or emotion

examples.en: The tuberculosis patient had a hectic flush on his unusually pale cheeks.
examples.zh: 那位肺结核患者异常苍白的双颊上泛着病态的潮红。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指肺病等引起的潮红、发热，常与 flush 或 fever 连用，书面语色彩浓。

lemmas.def_en: in a frenzied manner

examples.en: we rehearsed frenziedly the last few days before the premiere

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hectic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽大无袖长袍, 驼毛织物
lemmas.def_en: a loose sleeveless outer garment made from aba cloth; worn by Arabs

examples.en: The Bedouin elder wrapped his coarse woolen aba tightly around himself against the chill.
examples.zh: 那位贝都因长者将粗毛长袍裹紧以御寒风。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，专指中东地区的传统毛织物或宽大无袖长袍，常出现于文化与民族服饰语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aba 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 尖声急叫, 叫吠, 叫喊；叫喊着说
lemmas.def_en: bark in a high-pitched tone

examples.en: The puppy yelped when the heavy door accidentally shut on its paw.
examples.zh: 厚重的大门不小心夹到小狗的爪子时，它疼得尖叫了一声。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词指因疼痛或惊吓而发出的短促尖叫，常作不及物动词，主语为人或犬类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yelp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: thick woolen fabric used for clothing; originated in Scotland

examples.en: He wore an elegant jacket tailored from handwoven Harris tweed.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件用手工哈里斯粗花呢定制的典雅夹克。

lemmas.usage_note: 指粗花呢面料或花呢服装，常用搭配如 tweed jacket，多用于时尚与服饰描述。

lemmas.def_zh: 穿花呢服的, 穿着漂亮的, 松散悠闲的, 男子气概的
lemmas.def_en: of textiles; having a rough surface

examples.en: a sweater knitted of nubbly homespun yarns

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has red hair

examples.en: As a natural redhead, she always makes sure to apply sunscreen outdoors.
examples.zh: 作为一个天生红发的人，她在户外总是格外注意涂防晒霜。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指拥有天然红发的人，日常口语和描写人物外貌时极高频使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使困惑, 使复杂化, 使为难
lemmas.def_en: be a mystery or bewildering to

examples.en: The strange archaeological findings continue to perplex historians worldwide.
examples.zh: 这些奇特的考古发现继续让全世界的历史学家深感困惑。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指事物让人深感困惑或难以理解，宾语通常为表示人或思维的名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 困惑, 混乱状态, 使人困惑的事物
lemmas.def_en: trouble or confusion resulting from complexity

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 困惑的，茫然不知所措的
lemmas.def_en: completely baffled; very puzzled
lemmas.usage_note: 通常用作表语或定语修饰人及其表情、目光，表示因难以理解而感到困惑。

examples.en: He had a perplexed look on his face when he read the instructions.
examples.zh: 读到说明书时，他脸上露出了困惑的表情。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人困惑的，复杂的
lemmas.def_en: completely baffling; very puzzling
lemmas.usage_note: 用于修饰事物，如 a perplexing question / problem，表示事情复杂费解。

examples.en: The sudden disappearance of the documents remains a perplexing mystery.
examples.zh: 文件的突然失踪仍然是一个令人费解的谜团。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perplex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 揭穿, 暴露, 拆穿假面具
lemmas.def_en: expose while ridiculing; especially of pretentious or false claims and ideas

examples.en: The documentary set out to debunk several widespread urban myths.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片旨在揭穿几个流传甚广的都市传说。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常见搭配 debunk a myth/theory，多用于揭露伪科学或虚假说辞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 debunk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 斜的, 倾斜的, 间接的, 不光明正大的, 躲躲闪闪的
lemmas.def_en: slanting or inclined in direction or course or position--neither parallel nor perpendicular nor right-angled

examples.en: He made an oblique reference to the ongoing corruption investigation during his speech.
examples.zh: 他在演讲中拐弯抹角地提及了目前正在进行的腐败调查。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 angle、reference 或 approach，既指几何上的倾斜，也指表达时的间接与委婉。

lemmas.def_zh: 斜, 倾斜, 间接, 不光明正大, 躲躲闪闪
lemmas.def_en: to, toward or at one side

examples.en: darting eyes looking sidelong out of a wizened face

lemmas.def_zh: 倾斜, 精神错乱, 不坦率, 偏斜度
lemmas.def_en: the presentation during labor of the head of the fetus at an abnormal angle

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oblique 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 福音传道者, 圣经新约福音书的作者
lemmas.def_en: a preacher of the Christian gospel

examples.en: As a passionate tech evangelist, she traveled the country promoting open-source software.
examples.zh: 作为一名充满热情的科技布道者，她走遍全国推广开源软件。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指宗教布道者，也常用于科技或商业语境，指狂热推广某理念或技术的倡导者。

lemmas.def_zh: 福音传道, 福音传道者的工作, 福音主义
lemmas.def_en: zealous preaching and advocacy of the gospel

examples.en: The missionary dedicated most of his adult life to Christian evangelism abroad.
examples.zh: 这位传教士将成年后的大部分时光奉献给了海外基督教福音传播。

lemmas.def_zh: 福音书作者的, 福音传道者的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or promoting the preaching and dissemination of the Christian gospel

examples.en: evangelistic fervor
the evangelistic concerns of the early church

lemmas.def_zh: 传福音, 使信基督教；传福音, 传道
lemmas.def_en: preach the gospel (to)

examples.en: The group traveled abroad hoping to evangelize remote communities in the region.
examples.zh: 该团体前往海外，希望在该地区的偏远社区传福音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evangelist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 音乐剧, 传奇剧, 戏剧似的事件
lemmas.def_en: an extravagant comedy in which action is more salient than characterization

examples.en: Cut out the melodrama and just tell me what actually happened at the meeting.
examples.zh: 别再大惊小怪地演戏了，直接告诉我会议上到底发生了什么。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指夸张渲染情绪的情节剧，常带贬义引申为生活或言行中的小题大做、戏剧化场面。

lemmas.def_zh: 传奇剧风格的, 戏剧似的, 夸张的
lemmas.def_en: having the excitement and emotional appeal of melodrama

examples.en: a melodramatic account of two perilous days at sea

lemmas.def_en: as in a melodrama

examples.en: here, the hero is melodramatically reunited with the heroine

family_guide.root_logic: 以 melodrama 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: drench or submerge or be drenched or submerged

examples.en: A sudden summer downpour drenched the hikers before they could reach the shelter.
examples.zh: 突如其来的夏日暴雨把徒步旅行者们淋了个透，他们甚至来不及赶到避雨处。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于被动语态 be drenched in/with，生动表达被雨水浸透或被光线、汗水彻底笼罩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drench 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 工人, 工匠, 男工
lemmas.def_en: an employee who performs manual or industrial labor

examples.en: The experienced workman repaired the ancient stone wall with great precision.
examples.zh: 那位经验丰富的工匠极其精准地修复了这座古老的石墙。

lemmas.usage_note: 指体力劳动者或工匠，常见谚语搭配如 a bad workman blames his tools（劣工尤器）。

lemmas.def_en: skill in an occupation or trade

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a path set aside for walking

examples.en: An elevated covered walkway connects the terminal directly to the airport hotel.
examples.zh: 一条带顶棚的高架连廊将航站楼与机场酒店直接连接起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指专供行人通行的步道、天桥或连廊，多用于城市规划与建筑设计的书面语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 walkway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: without civilizing influences; ; ; ; -Margaret Meade

examples.en: Human rights organizations strongly condemned the barbaric treatment of political prisoners.
examples.zh: 人权组织强烈谴责了对政治犯所施加的野蛮残忍待遇。

lemmas.usage_note: 强烈贬义词，多用于正式或议论语境，强烈谴责极度残暴、未经开化或野蛮残忍的行径。

lemmas.def_zh: 残暴的行为, 残忍, 粗鄙
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being shockingly cruel and inhumane

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barbaric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肤色, 情况, 局面
lemmas.def_en: the coloring of a person's face

examples.en: The unexpected testimony completely changed the complexion of the entire criminal trial.
examples.zh: 这份出人意料的证词彻底改变了整场刑事审判的局势。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词可指面部肤色，亦常用于 change the complexion of 引申指彻底改变事态格局。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 体质; 面色, 面容
lemmas.def_en: give a certain color to

examples.en: Years of exposure to the sea wind had darkly complexioned his weathered face.
examples.zh: 长年经受海风的吹拂，使他饱经风霜的脸庞呈现出黝黑的面色。

lemmas.usage_note: 极为罕见的及物动词用法，多见于旧式或医学文献，表示赋予某种面色、色调或外貌特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 complexion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally

examples.en: After receiving the tragic news, she spent the rest of the afternoon walking around in a daze.
examples.zh: 得知这一悲痛的消息后，她整个下午都在恍恍惚惚中度过。

lemmas.usage_note: 极常用于固定搭配 in a daze，描述因震惊、击打或疲惫而处于精神恍惚、茫然不知所措的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 使茫然, 使发昏, 使眼花缭乱
lemmas.def_en: to cause someone to lose clear vision, especially from intense light

examples.en: The loud explosion dazed the driver for a few seconds before he realized what happened.
examples.zh: 巨大的爆炸声让司机发懵了几秒钟，随后他才意识到发生了什么。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态 be dazed by，指因重击、强光或惊人消息而使人发懵、目眩神迷。

lemmas.def_zh: 头昏眼花地, 眼花缭乱地, 茫然地
lemmas.def_en: in a daze; in a dazed manner

examples.en: he wondered dazedly whether the term after next at his new school wouldn't matter so much

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 头昏目眩的，恍惚的，发懵的
lemmas.def_en: unable to think clearly or act normally, especially as a result of shock, injury, or surprise
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于受重击、药物影响或遭遇突发打击后的状态，如 a dazed expression。

examples.en: Survivors were seen wandering around in a dazed state after the blast.
examples.zh: 爆炸发生后，有人看到幸存者在恍惚茫然的状态下四处游荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 热烈欢迎, 大喝采, 小凯旋式
lemmas.def_en: enthusiastic recognition (especially one accompanied by loud applause)

examples.en: The pianist received a tumultuous standing ovation at the end of her dazzling performance.
examples.zh: 钢琴家在演奏完令人赞叹的曲目后，赢得了全场观众雷鸣般的起立鼓掌。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 standing 连用构成 standing ovation（全场起立鼓掌），常搭配 give/receive 等动词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ovation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 荣誉, 赞美, 骑士爵位的授予礼, 连谱号
lemmas.def_en: a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction

examples.en: Her latest novel received the highest accolades from critics around the world.
examples.zh: 她的最新小说赢得了全世界评论家的高度赞誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数名词，指对成就的高度赞誉或殊荣；常与 win、receive、highest 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 accolade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a blue to grey green mineral consisting of copper aluminum phosphate

examples.en: The artisan set a polished turquoise into the handcrafted silver pendant.
examples.zh: 工匠将一颗打磨光滑的绿松石镶嵌在手工制作的银吊坠上。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指绿松石宝石（不可数或作材料），也可指蓝绿色（不可数）；多用于珠宝制作或色彩描述。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turquoise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 西门子（财富500强公司之一, 总部所在地德国, 主要经营电子电气）
lemmas.def_en: a unit of conductance equal to the reciprocal of an ohm

examples.en: Siemens announced plans to invest heavily in industrial automation technologies.
examples.zh: 西门子公司宣布了巨额投资工业自动化技术的计划。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母大写时指跨国企业西门子；首字母小写且单复数同形时为电导计量单位（西门子）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 siemens 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火柴制造, 缔缘, 做媒
lemmas.def_en: mediation in order to bring about a marriage between others

examples.en: Tired of family matchmaking, she decided to focus entirely on her career.
examples.zh: 厌倦了家人的牵线相亲，她决定全心投入到事业中。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，主要指撮合姻缘的作媒行为，现也广泛用于游戏中的自动匹配机制。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 matchmaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 紫外线的; 紫外线
lemmas.def_en: radiation lying in the ultraviolet range; wave lengths shorter than light but longer than X rays

examples.en: The telescope is specially designed to capture images in the extreme ultraviolet.
examples.zh: 该望远镜专门用于捕捉极紫外波段的图像。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，科学语境中指紫外线或紫外光谱，常与 in the ultraviolet 等介词短语连用。

lemmas.def_en: having or employing wavelengths shorter than light but longer than X-rays; lying outside the visible spectrum at its violet end

examples.en: You need to apply sunscreen to protect your skin from harmful ultraviolet radiation.
examples.zh: 你需要涂抹防晒霜，以保护皮肤免受有害紫外线辐射的伤害。

lemmas.usage_note: 定语形容词，修饰 radiation、light、rays 等，指波长短于可见光的紫外线的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ultraviolet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Judaism) a period of seven days of mourning after the death of close relative

examples.en: The entire family gathered to sit shiva for seven days following their grandfather's funeral.
examples.zh: 祖父的葬礼结束后，全家人聚在一起守了七天丧。

lemmas.usage_note: 犹太教传统中的七日服丧期，通常与动词 sit 搭配，构成固定短语 sit shiva（守丧）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shiva 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 故意毁坏文物的行为, 破坏他人财产的行为
lemmas.def_en: willful wanton and malicious destruction of the property of others

examples.en: The historic park suffered severe vandalism over the weekend, with several statues defaced.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的公园在周末遭到严重蓄意破坏，数座雕像被涂污。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指故意毁坏公物或他人财产的罪行，常与 act of、commit 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vandalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麻疹, 风疹, 家畜囊尾蚴病, 米珠
lemmas.def_en: an acute and highly contagious viral disease marked by distinct red spots followed by a rash; occurs primarily in children

examples.en: Measles is a highly contagious disease that can be prevented with a vaccine.
examples.zh: 麻疹是一种高度传染性的疾病，可以通过接种疫苗来预防。

lemmas.usage_note: 形式为复数但通常作单数看待的疾病名称，常与 have、catch、contract 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 measles 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the construction of ships

examples.en: The government provided substantial subsidies to support the domestic shipbuilding sector.
examples.zh: 政府提供了大笔补贴以扶持国内造船业。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指船舶制造工艺或造船产业，常修饰 industry、yard 或作句子主宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shipbuilding 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 简直不, 一定不, 仅仅
lemmas.def_en: only a very short time before; ; ; ; ; - W.B.Yeats

examples.en: He could scarcely breathe after running up five flights of stairs.
examples.zh: 他在一口气爬了五层楼梯后几乎喘不过气来。

lemmas.usage_note: 半否定副词，意为“几乎不”；常用于 scarcely... when... 句型，置于句首时句子需倒装。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scarcely 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 太古的, 原来的, 古时的, 原始的
lemmas.def_en: completely free from dirt or contamination

examples.en: The island is famous for its pristine white beaches and crystal-clear waters.
examples.zh: 该岛以其未受污染的洁白沙滩和清澈见底的海水而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰环境、自然状态或物品，表示未受破坏、崭新洁净的，多用于书面语中描写纯净风貌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pristine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of reproducing recorded sound

examples.en: You can check the recorded footage instantly using the video playback feature.
examples.zh: 你可以使用视频回放功能即时查看录制好的素材。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 audio、video 搭配，指音视频的重放过程或回放设备，广泛用于多媒体与日常交流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of illumination equal to 1 lumen per square meter; 0.0929 foot candle

examples.en: Standard office lighting typically requires an illuminance of about 500 lux.
examples.zh: 标准的办公室照明通常需要约500勒克斯的照度。

lemmas.usage_note: 光学物理专业名词，用作照度单位，常与具体数值搭配，单复数同形，多见于技术规范与说明书。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lux 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: writing implement consisting of a colored stick of composition wax used for writing and drawing

examples.en: The toddler happily drew a bright yellow sun on the paper with a red crayon.
examples.zh: 那个蹒跚学步的孩子用一支红蜡笔在纸上欢快地画了一个亮黄色的太阳。

lemmas.usage_note: 指儿童绘画用的彩色蜡笔或蜡笔画，常用作可数名词，常与 wax 或 a box of 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: write, draw, or trace with a crayon

examples.en: She sat quietly on the carpet and crayoned a colorful picture of her family.
examples.zh: 她静静地坐在地毯上，用蜡笔画了一幅色彩斑斓的家庭全家福。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，表示用蜡笔涂画或作画，常见搭配为 crayon on something，语气随和口语化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crayon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 飘浮着的, 在海上的, 浸满水的, 在进行中的
lemmas.def_en: aimlessly drifting

examples.en: The government subsidy was the only thing that kept the small business afloat.
examples.zh: 政府的补贴是维持这家小企业不致破产的唯一支柱。

lemmas.usage_note: 表语形容词，常与 stay、keep 连用，既可指物理上的漂浮，也可比喻在经济上勉强维持不负债。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 afloat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a subsonic jet airliner operated over short distances

examples.en: The airline announced plans to purchase ten new Airbus aircraft for regional flights.
examples.zh: 该航空公司宣布计划购买十架新型空中客车飞机用于支线航班。

lemmas.usage_note: 普通名词指短程宽体客机；首字母大写时专指“空中客车”客机品牌，多用于航空新闻与交通运输领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airbus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: written by hand

examples.en: She still treasures the handwritten letter her grandmother sent her decades ago.
examples.zh: 她依然珍藏着几十年前祖母写给她的那封亲笔信。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词作定语，修饰 letter、note、recipe 等，强调手工亲笔书写而非打印或机打，常带温情意味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handwritten 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 怪诞的, 可怕的, 奇异的, 令人迷惑不解的
lemmas.def_en: suggestive of the supernatural; mysterious

examples.en: An eerie silence fell over the abandoned house as midnight approached.
examples.zh: 随着午夜临近，一种诡异的死寂笼罩了这座废弃的宅邸。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常与 silence、glow、sound 搭配，描摹令人毛骨悚然、不可思议的怪异氛围，多见于文学描写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eerie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不久以后, 立刻, 以后
lemmas.def_en: at another time

examples.en: I must take my leave now, but I shall see you anon.
examples.zh: 我此刻必须告辞了，但我们不久后便会再见。

lemmas.usage_note: 古英语或诗歌用语，意为“不久、回头见”，现代常见于戏剧台词或文雅幽默的告别短语 ever and anon 中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the customary or habitual hour for eating lunch

examples.en: The cafeteria is always extremely crowded at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 自助餐厅在午餐时间总是极其拥挤。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指午餐时段，常与介词 at 搭配构成分词短语（at lunchtime），也可在名词前作定语修饰活动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lunchtime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a very attractive or seductive looking woman

examples.en: That black eye you got during the rugby match is a real lulu.
examples.zh: 你在橄榄球比赛中挨的那记乌青眼可真是非同小可。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语名词，常与 real/absolute 搭配，指非同寻常、引人注目的人或事物（褒贬皆可）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lulu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 格子花呢披风, 格子花呢, 格子图案
lemmas.def_en: a cloth having a crisscross design

examples.en: He wrapped himself in a warm wool plaid before heading into the winter chill.
examples.zh: 在走进冬日严寒之前，他用一条保暖的羊毛格子披风裹住了自己。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指苏格兰格子花呢或格子披风，常与 wear, wrap in 或 wool 搭配，多用于服饰语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plaid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: exploitation by a stronger country of weaker one; the use of the weaker country's resources to strengthen and enrich the stronger country

examples.en: The country's economic struggles are deeply rooted in the lingering legacy of colonialism.
examples.zh: 该国的经济困境深深植根于殖民主义遗留下的深远影响中。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式政治历史名词，不可数，常与 legacy of, fight against, Western 等词搭配，多用于学术政论。

lemmas.def_en: a believer in colonialism

examples.en: The young author wrote a passionate critique challenging the old colonialist mindset.
examples.zh: 这位年轻作家撰写了一篇充满激情的批评文章，挑战旧有的殖民主义心态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 colonialism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <美>牛栏,<口>大房间(尤指候审犯人用的),[棒球]候补队员区
lemmas.def_en: a place on a baseball field where relief pitchers can warm up during a game

examples.en: The manager called down to the bullpen to have the relief pitcher warm up.
examples.zh: 主教练向练投区打电话，让后援投手开始热身。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，棒球术语指投手练投区或后备投手群，引申用于大开间办公区；常与 call to, from the 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bullpen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large medieval vessel with a single deck propelled by sails and oars with guns at stern and prow; a complement of 1,000 men; used mainly in the Mediterranean for war and trading

examples.en: Slaves and prisoners were forced to row the ancient naval galley across the Mediterranean.
examples.zh: 奴隶和囚犯被迫划动这艘古代大型军舰穿行在地中海。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指古代单层或多层桨战舰，亦指船上/飞机上的厨房；历史语境常与 row, war 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 galley 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狄斯(阴间的神), 阴间, 冥府
lemmas.def_en: god of the underworld; counterpart of Greek Pluto

examples.en: In classical mythology, souls of the departed were believed to descend into Dis.
examples.zh: 在古典神话中，人们相信逝者的灵魂会堕入冥府。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词，常大写，指罗马神话中的冥王或冥界本身，主要用于文学、神话或历史学术语境。

lemmas.def_en: treat, mention, or speak to rudely

examples.en: The rapper used his latest single to openly diss his long-time rival.
examples.zh: 那位说唱歌手在他最新的单曲中公然羞辱了他的宿敌。

lemmas.usage_note: 俚语动词，源自 disrespect，指公然侮辱或贬低某人，常与 track, openly 连用，多见于流行文化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diss 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 傻笑, 假笑, 得意地笑
lemmas.def_en: smile affectedly or derisively

examples.en: He couldn't help but smirk when he saw his opponent make a clumsy blunder.
examples.zh: 当看到对手犯下低级失误时，他忍不住得意地冷笑起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指带着轻蔑、得意或自满的神情傻笑、假笑，常与 at 搭配使用，含贬义色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smirk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 旅程, 旅行指南, 游记
lemmas.def_en: an established line of travel or access

examples.en: We need to finalize our travel itinerary before booking the regional train tickets.
examples.zh: 在预订当地区间火车票之前，我们需要敲定旅行行程表。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指详细的旅行日程安排或路线，常与 plan, travel, detailed 搭配，多见于商务与旅游。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 itinerary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 虔诚的, 敬神的, 尽责的, 可嘉的, 不可能实现的
lemmas.def_en: having or showing or expressing reverence for a deity

examples.en: The elderly monk led a pious life dedicated to prayer and charity.
examples.zh: 这位年迈的僧侣过着专注于祈祷与慈善的虔诚生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指对宗教虔诚的，亦可指冠冕堂皇却难以实现的（如 pious hope），常修饰 life, belief。

lemmas.def_en: in a devout and pious manner

examples.en: she was devoutly Catholic

lemmas.def_en: righteousness by virtue of being pious

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a restraint that confines or restricts freedom (especially something used to tie down or restrain a prisoner)

examples.en: The reformer fought courageously to break the heavy shackles of outdated traditions.
examples.zh: 这位改革者勇敢奋斗，以打破过时传统的沉重桎梏。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常用复数 shackles，物理上指镣铐，引申为束缚或桎梏，常与 throw off, break 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: bind the arms of

examples.en: Excessive regulations continue to shackle the growth of small local businesses.
examples.zh: 过度的监管政策继续束缚着当地小型企业的发展。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指给……戴上枷锁，多引申为阻碍、束缚发展或自由，常用于被动语态或抽象语境。

lemmas.def_en: not bound by shackles and chains

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shackle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a spacecraft designed to carry a crew into interstellar space (especially in science fiction)

examples.en: The sci-fi novel depicts a colossal starship traveling toward the Alpha Centauri system.
examples.zh: 这部科幻小说描绘了一艘驶向半人马座阿尔法星系统的巨型恒星飞船。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于科幻文学与航天前沿领域，指跨越恒星系的载人飞船，常与launch、board搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 starship 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of biology that studies microorganisms and their effects on humans

examples.en: She decided to pursue a doctorate in clinical microbiology to study drug-resistant bacteria.
examples.zh: 她决定攻读临床微生物学博士学位，以研究耐药性细菌。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术术语，指研究微生物的生物学分支，常与department、research、degree等搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in microbiology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 microbiology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an impressive country house (or castle) in France

examples.en: During their trip to the Loire Valley, they stayed at a 16th-century historic chateau.
examples.zh: 在卢瓦尔河谷旅行期间，他们寄宿在一座建于16世纪的古老城堡庄园里。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自法语，专指法国乡间庄园大宅或葡萄酒庄，复数常写作châteaux，属书面及旅游用语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chateau 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （美）棒球场；活动领域；可变通范围
lemmas.def_en: a facility in which ball games are played (especially baseball games)

examples.en: The final renovation costs were reasonably in the right ballpark compared to the original bid.
examples.zh: 与最初的报价相比，最终的翻修成本大致在可接受的合理范围之内。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指棒球场，商业口语中常用于in the ballpark表示“大致范围、八九不离十”。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ballpark 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a single-reed woodwind with a conical bore

examples.en: The musician played a haunting solo on the alto saxophone throughout the slow movement.
examples.zh: 这位音乐家在中音萨克斯管上演奏了一段贯穿整个慢板乐章的萦绕心弦的独奏。

lemmas.usage_note: 音乐专用词，指萨克斯管，常与play搭配，前接alto、tenor等指定调性类型。

lemmas.def_en: a musician who plays the saxophone

family_guide.root_logic: 以 saxophone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侵犯, 侵蚀, 蚕食
lemmas.def_en: advance beyond the usual limit

examples.en: Urban development continues to encroach on the fragile wetlands surrounding the bay.
examples.zh: 城市开发正持续蚕食着海湾周围脆弱的湿地环境。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，后接介词on或upon，指逐步侵占权利、领地或时间，具消极语意。

lemmas.def_en: any entry into an area not previously occupied

examples.en: an invasion of tourists
an invasion of locusts

family_guide.root_logic: 以 encroach 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 支吾地说；支吾, 蹒跚地走
lemmas.def_en: be unsure or weak

examples.en: Her voice began to falter as she recounted the harrowing details of the accident.
examples.zh: 当她叙述起那场事故的惨痛细节时，声音开始颤抖结巴起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不及物动词，指步伐踉跄、声音颤抖或信心动摇，常修饰voice、steps或economy。

lemmas.def_zh: 不摇晃的, 坚定的, 不犹豫的
lemmas.def_en: marked by firm determination or resolution; not shakable

examples.en: firm convictions
a firm mouth

lemmas.def_en: in an unsteady manner

examples.en: he walked unsteadily toward the exit
The wounded soldier was swinging unsteadily on his legs

family_guide.root_logic: 以 falter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: touch or stroke lightly in a loving or endearing manner

examples.en: A gentle evening breeze caressed her face as she looked out over the ocean.
examples.zh: 当她眺望大海时，一缕轻柔的晚风抚过了她的脸庞。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指温柔地抚摸、轻抚，可用于人际爱抚，亦可拟人化修饰微风、光线等。

lemmas.def_en: a gentle affectionate stroking (or something resembling it)

examples.en: He comforted the frightened child with a soft word and a gentle caress on the head.
examples.zh: 他温言软语，并轻轻抚摸了一下受惊孩子的头部以示安慰。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指轻抚、爱抚的动作，常与gentle、tender搭配，富含温情色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting)

examples.en: The university campus has become the primary locus of political debate in the city.
examples.zh: 该大学校园已成为这座城市政治辩论的核心发生地。
