lemmas.def_en: tending to entice into a desired action or state

examples.en: The company presented a seductive offer that made it difficult for her to refuse.
examples.zh: 该公司提出了一个极具诱惑力的提议，让她很难拒绝。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容人性感迷人，或事物极具诱惑力；常修饰 voice, smile, aroma 或 offer。

lemmas.def_zh: 诱惑地; 富有魅力地; 勾引地
lemmas.def_en: in a tempting seductive manner

examples.en: she smiled at him seductively

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seductive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 框格, 肩带, 腰带
lemmas.def_en: a framework that holds the panes of a window in the window frame

examples.en: The beauty queen waved to the cheering crowd while wearing an embroidered silk sash.
examples.zh: 选美皇后佩戴着刺绣丝绸饰带，向欢呼的人群挥手致意。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指礼仪佩戴的肩带或腰带，也指窗户的窗框；修饰人时常与 wear 或 tie 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: impart gradually

examples.en: The new manager sought to transfuse fresh energy and ambition into the struggling team.
examples.zh: 新经理试图为这个陷入困境的团队注入新鲜的活力与抱负。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指输血，文学上常比喻将某种精神、活力或观念灌输渗透给他人；常与介词 into 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 倾注, 输血, 输液
lemmas.def_en: the introduction of blood or blood plasma into a vein or artery

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transfuse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 突然放下, 支持, 使丰满, 使鼓起；扑通落下, 投票赞成, 变丰满, 鼓起
lemmas.def_en: drop sharply

examples.en: She quickly plumped the cushions on the sofa before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 她在客人到来之前迅速把沙发上的靠垫拍松。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词常指拍松垫子使之鼓起，不及物动词 plump for 意为选择或支持，亦可指重重落下。

lemmas.def_zh: 圆胖的, 丰满的, 直接下落的, 直率的
lemmas.def_en: sufficiently fat so as to have a pleasing fullness of figure

examples.en: The children gathered bowls of plump, sweet blueberries in the garden.
examples.zh: 孩子们在花园里采摘了一碗碗饱满多汁的甜蓝莓。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作委婉褒义词形容人丰满微胖，或形容水果饱满多汁；修饰 cheeks, figure 或 berries。

lemmas.def_en: the bodily property of being well rounded

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plump 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狗舍, 狗屋, 阴沟
lemmas.def_en: outbuilding that serves as a shelter for a dog

examples.en: We had to leave our golden retriever at a boarding kennel during our vacation.
examples.zh: 度假期间，我们不得不把金毛寻回犬寄养在一家寄养狗舍。

lemmas.usage_note: 指户外的狗窝、狗舍，复数 kennels 常指专业的养狗场或寄养所；常接介词 in。

lemmas.def_zh: 置于狗舍, 宿于狗舍；进狗窝
lemmas.def_en: put up in a kennel

examples.en: The trainer told us to kennel the hounds immediately after the evening hunt.
examples.zh: 驯兽师吩咐我们在傍晚狩猎结束后立即将猎犬关进狗舍。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词指把狗关进狗窝或送去寄养，不及物动词指进窝栖息；多用于养犬专业语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kennel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 挫伤, 扭筋, 错筋
lemmas.def_en: twist suddenly so as to sprain

examples.en: She accidentally tripped over a tree root and sprained her right ankle.
examples.zh: 她不小心被树根绊倒，扭伤了右脚踝。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常医疗及运动损伤词汇，指关节或韧带扭伤；高频宾语为 ankle, wrist 等身体部位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sprain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a college or university building containing living quarters for students

examples.en: First-year students are usually required to live in the university dormitory.
examples.zh: 大学一年级新生通常被要求住在学校宿舍里。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指学校或机构的集体宿舍，口语中常略作 dorm，常见搭配如 college dormitory 或 dormitory building。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dormitory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of the short curved hairs that grow from the edges of the eyelids

examples.en: She applied a layer of mascara to make her eyelashes look longer and thicker.
examples.zh: 她涂了一层睫毛膏，使自己的睫毛看起来更长更浓密。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常以复数形式 eyelashes 出现，常用搭配有 false eyelashes（假睫毛）与 mascara（睫毛膏）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eyelash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: move very slightly

examples.en: Despite hours of intense negotiation, neither side was willing to budge an inch.
examples.zh: 尽管进行了数小时的艰难谈判，双方都不愿意退让半步。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于否定句中，表示物理上的“挪动”或态度上的“妥协让步”，常见搭配如 refuse to budge 或 won't budge。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 budge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 衣衫褴褛的, 低劣的, 破旧的, 吝啬的, 卑鄙的
lemmas.def_en: showing signs of wear and tear

examples.en: He walked into the job interview wearing a shabby coat that had seen better days.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件破旧不堪的外套走进了求职面试室。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容物品破旧、衣衫褴褛，也可引申指行为卑劣不公，常修饰 clothes、furniture 或 treatment。

lemmas.def_zh: 衣衫褴褛地, 不体面地, 卑鄙地
lemmas.def_en: so as to appear worn and threadbare or dilapidated

examples.en: a shabbily dressed man

lemmas.def_zh: 衣衫褴褛, 吝啬, 卑鄙
lemmas.def_en: a lack of elegance as a consequence of wearing threadbare or dirty clothing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shabby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous plants of the family Compositae and especially of the genera Carduus and Cirsium and Onopordum having prickly-edged leaves

examples.en: The purple blossom of the thistle stood out sharply against the dry, rocky hillside.
examples.zh: 蓟草紫色的花朵在干燥多石的山坡上显得格外醒目。

lemmas.usage_note: 指蓟属野生植物，叶具尖刺，头状花序，常作为苏格兰的国家象征出现，为普通可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thistle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an artisan who makes jewelry and other objects out of gold

examples.en: The skilled goldsmith engraved an intricate floral pattern onto the custom wedding band.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的金匠在这枚定制婚戒上雕刻了精致的花卉图案。

lemmas.usage_note: 指制作或修理金制品的金匠、金工，多用于手工艺、珠宝设计及历史语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goldsmith 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (football) the running back who plays the fullback position on the offensive team

examples.en: The coach praised the young fullback for making a decisive tackle near the goal line.
examples.zh: 教练赞扬了这位年轻后卫在球门线附近做出的决定性铲球。

lemmas.usage_note: 体育术语，指足球、橄榄球或美式橄榄球等运动中的后卫，常与 play as 或 starting 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: play the fullback

examples.en: After their star defender suffered an injury, she was asked to fullback for the remainder of the season.
examples.zh: 在主力防守球员受伤后，她被要求在本赛季剩余的比赛中担任后卫。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见的动词化用法，主要用于体育语境，指在比赛中“担任后卫一职”，不及物为主。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fullback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: measuring instrument for measuring temperature

examples.en: The nurse placed a digital thermometer under the patient's tongue to check for a fever.
examples.zh: 护士将电子体温计放入病人的舌下以检查是否发烧。

lemmas.usage_note: 指测量气温或体温的温度计，常用搭配包括 clinical thermometer（体温计）及 check/read the thermometer。

lemmas.def_en: the measurement of temperature

examples.en: Infrared thermometry allows doctors to measure body temperatures quickly and without direct contact.
examples.zh: 红外测温法使医生无需直接接触即可快速测量体温。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to thermometry

examples.en: helium gas was the thermometric fluid

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thermometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 放置架子上, 搁置；渐渐倾斜
lemmas.def_en: hold back to a later time

examples.en: Due to a lack of funding, the municipal committee decided to shelve the subway expansion plan.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金，市政委员会决定搁置地铁扩建计划。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指将书等放上架子，更常比喻“搁置、暂缓计划”，及物用法居多，如 shelve plans/projects。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shelve 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 熟练技术, 巧妙手法, 诀窍
lemmas.def_en: a special way of doing something

examples.en: She has an extraordinary knack for calming down crying infants within minutes.
examples.zh: 她有一种非凡的本领，能在几分钟内让哭闹的婴儿平静下来。

lemmas.usage_note: 指掌握某种巧妙技能或特长，极常与 have a knack for/of 搭配，也可表示有做某事的习惯性倾向。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 窗玻璃, 方框, 方格, 窗格
lemmas.def_en: sheet glass cut in shapes for windows or doors

examples.en: A flying baseball shattered the window pane into dozens of sharp fragments.
examples.zh: 飞来的棒球将窗玻璃砸成了数十块锋利的碎片。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指装在窗框或门框上的单块玻璃，常见搭配有 a pane of glass，多用于具体空间描写。

lemmas.def_zh: 上下左右移动, 摇镜头, 淘洗, 淘金
lemmas.def_en: make a sweeping movement

examples.en: The director slowly panned the camera across the majestic mountain range.
examples.zh: 导演缓缓转动摄影机镜头，掠过雄伟的山峦。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于摄影摄像领域表示横向或纵向移动镜头，常接介词 across 或 round，也可指淘金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 坚决的, 刚毅的, 毅然的
lemmas.def_en: firm in purpose or belief; characterized by firmness and determination

examples.en: Her resolute refusal to compromise forced the management to reconsider the proposal.
examples.zh: 她断然拒绝妥协，迫使管理层重新考虑该提案。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容态度、信念或行动坚定不移，多褒义；常与 in、against 连用，或修饰 action、attempt 等词。

lemmas.def_en: showing firm determination or purpose

examples.en: she resolutely refused to look at him or speak to him
he entered the building resolutely

lemmas.def_en: the trait of being resolute

examples.en: his resoluteness carried him through the battle
it was his unshakeable resolution to finish the work

family_guide.root_logic: 以 resolute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 偷懒的, 懒惰的, 迟钝的
lemmas.def_en: moving slowly

examples.en: After taking the heavy cold medication, he felt remarkably sluggish all afternoon.
examples.zh: 吃了强效感冒药后，他整个下午都觉得反应异常迟钝。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰经济增长、新陈代谢、反应或交通运行，表示缓慢无活力，高频搭配有 sluggish economy。

lemmas.def_zh: 不振, 萧条, 呆滞; 惰性; 滞性; 惯性
lemmas.def_en: a state of comatose torpor (as found in sleeping sickness)
in a sluggish manner

examples.en: the smoke rose sluggishly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sluggish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several large deciduous trees with rounded spreading crowns and smooth grey bark and small sweet edible triangular nuts enclosed in burs; north temperate regions

examples.en: The autumn breeze rustled the golden leaves of the ancient beech tree.
examples.zh: 秋风吹拂着那棵古老山毛榉树的金黄落叶，沙沙作响。

lemmas.usage_note: 植物学及林业名词，指山毛榉树或其木材，常用于家具制造与林相描述，可作定语修饰 wood 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beech 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: situated farthest from point of attachment or origin, as of a limb or bone

examples.en: The surgeon carefully examined the fracture located at the distal end of the radius.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了位于桡骨远端的骨折部位。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学与生物医学专业形容词，指远离身体中心或起点部位的末梢、远端，常修饰 phalanx、end。

lemmas.def_en: far from the center

examples.en: the bronchus is situated distally

family_guide.root_logic: 以 distal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 熔渣, 矿渣, 无足轻重的人
lemmas.def_en: the scum formed by oxidation at the surface of molten metals

examples.en: Workers transported carts of molten slag away from the glowing blast furnace.
examples.zh: 工人们用推车将炽热高炉中排出的熔渣运走。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指冶炼金属时产生的矿渣，属工业不可数名词；英式俚语中作可数名词时指品行不端的人。

lemmas.def_en: convert into slag

examples.en: If the temperature rises too high, the mineral additives will slag rapidly in the kiln.
examples.zh: 如果温度升得过高，窑内的矿物添加剂将迅速矿渣化。

lemmas.usage_note: 在工业语境指转化成炉渣；而在英式口语中常作 slag off，表示严厉批评或诋毁某人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slag 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (mathematics, logic) such that the arguments or roles can be interchanged

examples.en: These precision mechanical components are interchangeable with parts from the newer model.
examples.zh: 这些精密机械部件可以与新型号的零件相互替换。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示部件、词语或概念可以相互替换，后常接介词 with，高频搭配如 interchangeable parts。

lemmas.def_zh: 可交换性, 互换性, 可交替性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being capable of exchange or interchange

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interchangeable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 钟摆, 摇锤, 摇摆不定的事态(或局面)
lemmas.def_en: an apparatus consisting of an object mounted so that it swings freely under the influence of gravity

examples.en: The brass pendulum swung rhythmically back and forth inside the grandfather clock.
examples.zh: 黄铜钟摆在祖父式大摆钟内有节奏地来回晃动。

lemmas.usage_note: 指物理上的钟摆，亦常比喻政治、民意等在两极间剧烈摆动的事态，常见搭配 swing of the pendulum。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pendulum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: thin unleavened pancake made from cornmeal or wheat flour

examples.en: She heated a corn tortilla on the griddle before wrapping the spicy meat filling.
examples.zh: 她先在铁板上加热玉米薄饼，然后卷入香辣的肉馅。

lemmas.usage_note: 烹饪文化词汇，专指墨西哥玉米薄饼或面粉薄饼，也可指西班牙式厚蛋饼，常搭配 fill、wrap 等动词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tortilla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the fourteenth and just before the sixteenth in position

examples.en: The historic cathedral was heavily renovated during the fifteenth century.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的大教堂在十五世纪期间进行了大规模翻修。

lemmas.usage_note: 序数词充当定语，表示次序或顺位为第十五的，常置于名词前修饰 century、anniversary 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fifteenth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 硬化症, 硬化, 僵化
lemmas.def_en: any pathological hardening or thickening of tissue

examples.en: Bureaucratic sclerosis has severely delayed the approval of the critical infrastructure project.
examples.zh: 官僚体制的僵化严重延误了这个关键基础设施项目的审批。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指医学上的组织硬化，亦可引申指机构体制的僵化，常与multiple连用或用于比喻语境。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or having sclerosis; hardened

examples.en: The patient was diagnosed with severe sclerotic changes in the walls of his major arteries.
examples.zh: 该患者被诊断为其主要动脉壁出现了严重的硬化病变。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sclerosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or involving the stomach

examples.en: Chronic stress is often cited as a contributing factor to severe gastric ulcers.
examples.zh: 长期的精神压力常被认为是导致严重胃溃疡的诱因之一。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学专业形容词，专指与胃部相关的生理或病理现象，常修饰juice、ulcer、bypass等名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gastric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 魔鬼似的, 穷凶极恶的, 邪恶的, 非常残酷的, 罪恶的, 极恶劣的
lemmas.def_en: extremely evil or cruel; expressive of cruelty or befitting hell

examples.en: The dictator was condemned internationally for his satanic cruelty toward political dissidents.
examples.zh: 该独裁者因对政治异见人士实施魔鬼般的残酷暴行而受到国际社会的谴责。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语与文学语体常用，既可指与撒旦崇拜相关的宗教现象，也形容穷凶极恶、令人发指的恶行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 satanic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: liable to or deserving punishment

examples.en: Under maritime law, acts of piracy are punishable by life imprisonment.
examples.zh: 根据海商法，海盗行为可被处以终身监禁。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律正式用语，表示某种行为依法应当受罚，常见搭配为be punishable by加具体刑罚手段。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 punishable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 圣像牌, (大弥撒中的)接吻礼, 和平女神
lemmas.def_en: (Roman Catholic Church) a greeting signifying Christian love for those assisting at the Eucharist

examples.en: During the high mass, the priest kissed the pax before passing it down the altar.
examples.zh: 在大弥撒期间，神父在将圣像牌传下祭坛之前亲吻了它。

lemmas.usage_note: 源于拉丁语，多用于宗教仪式（吻礼、圣像牌）或借指特定时期的和平霸权（如Pax Romana）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pax 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shout or song of praise to God

examples.en: A spontaneous hallelujah rose from the congregation as the choir finished the anthem.
examples.zh: 当合唱团唱完赞美诗时，会众中自发响起了一片赞美上帝的欢呼声。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为名词时指称赞美上帝的颂歌或欢呼声，常作可数名词，用于宗教礼拜或表达极度庆幸的语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hallelujah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: childcare during the day while parents work

examples.en: Working parents often struggle to find reliable and affordable daycare for their infants.
examples.zh: 双职工父母常常难以给婴儿找到可靠且负担得起的日托服务。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词指日间照料服务，亦可指日托中心（daycare center），常与provide、send to连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daycare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an Irish girl

examples.en: The folk song tells the tragic romance of a charming young colleen from County Cork.
examples.zh: 这首民歌讲述了一位来自科克郡的迷人少女的凄美爱情故事。

lemmas.usage_note: 爱尔兰英语词汇，具有浓郁的地方色彩与文学韵味，专指年轻未婚的少女或姑娘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 colleen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: spin,wind, or twist together

examples.en: The ivy vines intertwine along the stone wall, creating a natural green barrier.
examples.zh: 常春藤藤蔓沿着石墙相互缠绕，筑成了一道天然的绿色屏障。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指实物之间的物理缠绕，也广泛引申为命运、历史或情节的交织纠缠，常用于被动语态或不及物用法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intertwine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the savage and excessive killing of many people

examples.en: Paramedics were deeply shaken by the scene of horrific carnage on the highway after the collision.
examples.zh: 连环撞车事故发生后，高速公路上惨绝人寰的死伤现场让医护人员深受震撼。

lemmas.usage_note: 强烈的不可数名词，用于描述战场、重大灾难或恐怖袭击中极其惨烈的大规模死伤场景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carnage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hard grey-black mineral consisting of corundum and either hematite or magnetite; used as an abrasive (especially as a coating on paper)

examples.en: She smoothed the rough edges of her fingernails using a fine emery board.
examples.zh: 她用一把细金刚砂指甲锉修平了指甲的毛边。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指用于打磨抛光的细矿粉或砂石，常见搭配有 emery board（指甲锉）和 emery paper（砂纸）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a photographer who operates a movie camera

examples.en: The news cameraman dashed forward to capture the dramatic rescue on tape.
examples.zh: 新闻摄影师冲上前去，用摄像机记录下了这场惊心动魄的救援。

lemmas.usage_note: 指操作摄影机拍摄影视或新闻的专业人员，复数形式为 cameramen，现代语境中也可用 camera operator。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cameraman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant

examples.en: Don't forget to eat all your veg before asking for dessert.
examples.zh: 吃甜点之前，别忘了把你盘里的蔬菜都吃完。

lemmas.usage_note: 为 vegetable 的非正式口语缩写，单复数同形（meat and two veg），多用于英式日常会话中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 veg 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make a fool or dupe of

examples.en: The con artist managed to gull the investors into backing his nonexistent venture.
examples.zh: 那个骗子成功诱骗了投资者，让他们出资支持自己子虚乌有的项目。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面或文学色彩较浓，指利用他人的轻信进行欺骗，常用于 gull somebody into doing something 结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gull 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 抑郁的, 阻抑的, 压低的
lemmas.def_en: someone suffering psychological depression

examples.en: Clinical therapies have proven highly effective for many long-term depressives.
examples.zh: 临床治疗已被证实对许多长期抑郁症患者极为有效。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与心理学语境中作名词，专指患有抑郁症的人，语气较为客观专业，通常为可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 depressive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a measuring instrument that sends out an acoustic pulse in water and measures distances in terms of the time for the echo of the pulse to return

examples.en: The submarine navigated through the narrow strait using advanced passive sonar.
examples.zh: 该潜艇利用先进的被动声呐穿过了狭窄的海峡。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母缩略词，作不可数名词指声呐技术或系统，常见搭配 active/passive sonar、sonar detection 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sonar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a general officer ranking below a major general

examples.en: The troops saluted as the brigadier arrived to inspect the military base.
examples.zh: 当陆军准将抵达视察军事基地时，部队肃立敬礼。

lemmas.usage_note: 指英国陆军或海军陆战队中的准将（高于上校），也常作为官衔头衔置于姓名前大写使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brigadier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden and violent collapse

examples.en: The product launch turned into a total fiasco due to repeated technical glitches.
examples.zh: 由于技术故障接连不断，产品发布会彻底沦为了一场大笑话。

lemmas.usage_note: 指彻底且令人难堪的失败或滑稽闹剧，常与动词 end in 或 turn into 连用，多作单数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fiasco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阿姨, 姨妈, 舅妈, 姑妈, 伯母
lemmas.def_en: the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle

examples.en: My auntie always knits warm woolen sweaters for us every Christmas.
examples.zh: 我阿姨每年圣诞节都会为我们织温暖的羊毛衫。

lemmas.usage_note: aunt 的亲昵称谓（亦可拼作 aunty），用于亲属称呼或儿童对年长女性朋友的亲切称呼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 auntie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宁静, 沉着, 晴朗
lemmas.def_en: a disposition free from stress or emotion

examples.en: The gentle sound of the waves brought a profound sense of serenity to her mind.
examples.zh: 轻柔的海浪声给她的心灵带来了一种深切的宁静感。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数抽象名词，形容心境或外在环境的平静祥和，常与 shatter、restore 或 enjoy 等动词连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 serenity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: broken husks of the seeds of cereal grains that are separated from the flour by sifting

examples.en: Adding a spoonful of wheat bran to your morning yogurt provides a healthy dose of dietary fiber.
examples.zh: 在早晨的酸奶中加入一勺麦麸可以提供健康的膳食纤维。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指谷物外壳制成的麸皮，不可数名词，多见于健康饮食搭配如 oat bran 或 bran flakes。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bran 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of a light greyish-brown color

examples.en: She wore an elegant beige trench coat that matched her minimalist autumn wardrobe.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件优雅的米色风衣，与她极简主义的秋季衣橱十分相配。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词修饰服装、装饰风格，指米色或米黄色的，引申可口语化表示平淡乏味的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beige 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 敏锐地, 巧妙地, 精细地
lemmas.def_en: in a subtle manner

examples.en: The actor subtly changed his facial expression to convey the character's hidden sorrow.
examples.zh: 演员微妙地改变了面部表情，以传达角色内心深处的悲伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰动词或形容词，表示不易察觉地、巧妙微细地，常与 change, alter, differ 等连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subtly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: organization of performers and associated personnel (especially theatrical)

examples.en: A traveling dance troupe arrived in the small town to perform for the annual festival.
examples.zh: 一个巡回舞蹈团来到这座小镇，为一年一度的节日登台表演。

lemmas.usage_note: 集合名词，专指巡回演出的剧团、马戏团或舞蹈团，常与 touring 或 dance 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 troupe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 掷回, 挫折, 阻止
lemmas.def_en: an organism that has the characteristics of a more primitive type of that organism

examples.en: The band's new album is a delightful throwback to the classic rock era of the 1970s.
examples.zh: 该乐队的新专辑是对20世纪70年代经典摇滚时代一次令人愉悦的致敬与重温。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 to 连用，指令人联想到过去的复古之物或返祖现象，多用于文化和时尚语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 throwback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使年轻, 使复原, 使恢复精神；返老还童, 复原
lemmas.def_en: cause (a stream or river) to erode, as by an uplift of the land

examples.en: A weekend spa retreat helped rejuvenate her tired body after months of intense work.
examples.zh: 数月的高强度工作后，周末的温泉疗养帮她疲惫的身心恢复了活力。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词多表示使机构、经济焕发新生或让人容光焕发，不及物较少见，常作及物用法。

lemmas.def_en: the phenomenon of vitality and freshness being restored

examples.en: the annual rejuvenation of the landscape

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rejuvenate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 强烈的, 寒冷而干燥的, 活泼的
lemmas.def_en: quick and energetic

examples.en: Taking a brisk morning walk in the park is an excellent way to boost your circulation.
examples.zh: 早晨在公园里快步走是促进血液循环的极佳方式。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容步伐轻快敏捷（brisk walk）、生意兴隆（brisk trade）或天气凉爽清新（brisk wind）。

lemmas.def_zh: 活泼地, 精神勃勃地
lemmas.def_en: in a brisk manner

examples.en: she walked briskly in the cold air
`after lunch,' she said briskly

lemmas.def_en: liveliness and eagerness

examples.en: he accepted with alacrity
the smartness of the pace soon exhausted him

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brisk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 警戒, 监视, 守夜
lemmas.def_en: a period of sleeplessness

examples.en: The devoted parents kept a constant bedside vigil until their sick child finally woke up.
examples.zh: 悉心照料的父母一直守在床前，直到生病的孩子终于苏醒过来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与动词 keep, hold 搭配，多指彻夜守夜、祈祷或在病榻前的看护守候。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vigil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浓粥, 感伤的话, 软块
lemmas.def_en: any soft or soggy mass

examples.en: After being left in the rain all afternoon, the cardboard boxes turned into complete mush.
examples.zh: 在雨里淋了整整一个下午后，那些纸箱全变成了一团烂泥糊状。

lemmas.usage_note: 指烂糊状的物体或毫无价值的感伤言辞，常与 turn into 搭配表示糊成一团。

lemmas.def_en: a traveler who drives (or travels with) a dog team

lemmas.def_zh: 糊状物; 脆弱的感情, 感伤
lemmas.def_en: a mushy pulpy softness

lemmas.def_zh: 浓粥状的, 含糊不清, 感伤的
lemmas.def_en: having the consistency of mush
drive (a team of dogs or a dogsled)

examples.en: The experienced musher commanded his team to mush through the dense Alaskan blizzard.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的雪橇夫驱使着他的狗队穿越阿拉斯加稠密的暴风雪向前挺进。

lemmas.usage_note: 北极及雪地特有动词，指赶狗拉雪橇或带狗橇跋涉，亦可用作命令雪橇犬前行的口令。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肉峰, 预感, 大块
lemmas.def_en: an impression that something might be the case

examples.en: I had a strong hunch that our flight would be delayed due to the approaching storm.
examples.zh: 我有一种强烈的直觉，暴风雨来临会导致我们的航班延误。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指直觉、预感，高频搭配有 have a hunch that...，口语与日常书面均很常见。

lemmas.def_zh: 弯腰驼背, 预感到, 耸肩；向前移动, 隆起
lemmas.def_en: round one's back by bending forward and drawing the shoulders forward

examples.en: He hunched his shoulders against the freezing wind as he waited at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 在公交站等车时，他耸起肩膀缩着身子以抵御刺骨的寒风。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，常与 up 或 over 连用，表示弯腰弓背或耸起肩膀以抵御严寒等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hunch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易碎的, 脆弱的, 易坏的
lemmas.def_en: having little elasticity; hence easily cracked or fractured or snapped

examples.en: Cold winter temperatures made the plastic pipes brittle and prone to cracking easily.
examples.zh: 寒冬的气温使塑料管道变得脆弱，极易开裂。

lemmas.def_en: firm but easily broken

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brittle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: land where grass or grasslike vegetation grows and is the dominant form of plant life

examples.en: Vast herds of wild antelopes migrate across the African grassland every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，大批野生羚羊都会迁徙穿过非洲大草原。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grassland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or affecting the viscera

examples.en: The horror movie provoked a visceral reaction of pure terror among the audience.
examples.zh: 这部恐怖片在观众中引发了发自内心的极度恐惧。

lemmas.def_zh: visceral（内脏的；发自肺腑的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: in an unreasoning visceral manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 visceral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or containing an alkali; having a pH greater than 7

examples.en: Certain types of desert plants thrive exceptionally well in dry, alkaline soil.
examples.zh: 某些类型的沙漠植物在干燥的碱性土壤中生长得极好。

lemmas.def_en: pH values above 7

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alkaline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地方长官的职位(或辖区), 县
lemmas.def_en: the district administered by a prefect (as in France or Japan or the Roman Empire)

examples.en: They traveled to a distant Japanese prefecture to view the famous cherry blossoms.
examples.zh: 他们前往日本的一个偏远县份去观赏著名的樱花。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a prefecture

examples.en: a prefectural museum

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prefecture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 祸根, 毒药, 灭亡的原因, 灭亡
lemmas.def_en: something causing misery or death

examples.en: Constant smartphone notifications have become the absolute bane of my daily productivity.
examples.zh: 不断响起的手机通知已成为影响我日常工作效率的祸根。

lemmas.def_en: forbid the public distribution of ( a movie or a newspaper)

examples.en: The city council voted to ban single-use plastic bags in all supermarkets.
examples.zh: 市议会投票决定在所有超市禁止使用一次性塑料袋。

lemmas.def_en: exceedingly harmful

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not acknowledging the God of Christianity and Judaism and Islam

examples.en: Ancient chroniclers often condemned neighboring nomadic tribes as heathen and utterly barbaric.
examples.zh: 古代编年史家常将邻近的游牧部落贬为异教徒和彻头彻尾的野蛮人。

lemmas.def_zh: 异教徒, 异族人, 粗野的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who does not acknowledge your god

examples.en: Ancient chroniclers often condemned neighboring nomadic tribes as heathen and utterly barbaric.
examples.zh: 古代编年史家常将邻近的游牧部落贬为异教徒和彻头彻尾的野蛮人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heathen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 旗, 海军少尉, 徽章
lemmas.def_en: a person who holds a commissioned rank in the United States Navy or the United States Coast Guard; below lieutenant junior grade

examples.en: After graduating from the naval academy, he began his career as an ensign.
examples.zh: 从海军学院毕业后，他作为一名海军少尉开启了职业生涯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ensign 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mostly white aquatic bird having long pointed wings and short legs

examples.en: A noisy seagull swooped down and snatched the sandwich right from his hand.
examples.zh: 一只吵闹的海鸥俯冲下来，一把夺走了他手中的三明治。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seagull 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person engaged to care for children when the parents are not home

examples.en: They hired a reliable babysitter to look after their twins for the evening.
examples.zh: 他们请了一位可靠的临时保姆在晚上照看他们的双胞胎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 babysitter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: knitted jacket that is fastened up the front with buttons or a zipper

examples.en: She wrapped a warm knitted cardigan around herself as the evening grew chilly.
examples.zh: 夜幕降临寒意渐起，她给自己套了一件保暖的针织开襟羊毛衫。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常指前开襟、用纽扣或拉链系合的针织羊毛衫，常见搭配如 knitted cardigan 或 button-up cardigan。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cardigan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 内爆, 向内破裂, 爆裂
lemmas.def_en: burst inward

examples.en: Under intense market competition, the debt-ridden enterprise began to implode from within.
examples.zh: 在激烈的市场竞争下，这家负债累累的企业开始从内部走向瓦解。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物动词，既指物理上的向内坍塌内爆，也常引申为组织、系统或政权迅速瓦解崩溃。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden inward collapse

examples.en: the implosion of a light bulb

family_guide.root_logic: 以 implode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不信神, 无信仰, 背信
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being unfaithful

examples.en: Suspicions of marital infidelity eventually drove the couple to seek a divorce.
examples.zh: 对婚姻不忠的猜疑最终迫使这对夫妇走到了离婚的地步。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于婚姻情感语境指不忠或婚外情，正式文体中亦可表示对宗教信仰或誓言的背弃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 infidelity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: derange mentally, throw out of mental balance; make insane

examples.en: Prolonged isolation and relentless stress seemed to derange the prisoner's mind.
examples.zh: 长期的隔离与无休止的压力似乎让那名囚犯的精神陷入了错乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，书面语。常指扰乱正常运作、程序，或使某人精神错乱、发狂，常用被动语态。

lemmas.def_zh: 捣乱, 紊乱, 精神错乱, 混乱, 搅乱, 扰乱
lemmas.def_en: a state of mental disturbance and disorientation

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 精神错乱的，疯狂的
lemmas.def_en: unable to think or act in a normal or logical way especially because of severe mental illness; insane
lemmas.usage_note: 多用于法律、精神医学背景或新闻报道中，指行为极度异常或心理失常的人或行为。

examples.en: The attack was carried out by a deranged gunman.
examples.zh: 袭击是由一名精神错乱的枪手实施的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 derange 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 家臣, 侍从, 保持者
lemmas.def_en: a fee charged in advance to retain the services of someone

examples.en: The law firm requires an upfront retainer before their attorneys begin working on the case.
examples.zh: 律师事务所在其律师着手处理案件之前需要收取一笔预付款。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代多指聘请律师等的预付服务费，也指牙齿矫正保持器；历史文体中指家臣、随从。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 retainer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 通电, 镀锌, 使...感到震惊
lemmas.def_en: to stimulate to action

examples.en: The urgent climate report helped galvanize global leaders into taking immediate action.
examples.zh: 那份紧急的气候报告激励了全球领导人立即采取切实行动。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，主要引申为刺激、激励某人迅速行动，常与 into action/into doing 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 通电流于, 给...镀锌, 电镀, 刺激, 使兴奋, 激动, 激励, 惊起
lemmas.def_en: to stimulate to action

examples.en: ..startled him awake
galvanized into action

lemmas.def_zh: 通电, 镀锌, 震惊
lemmas.def_en: stimulation with a galvanic current

lemmas.def_zh: 电流的, 电流引起的, 使人震惊的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to or producing electric current by chemical action

examples.en: The scientist observed a galvanic reaction when two metals touched.
examples.zh: 科学家观察到了两种金属接触时产生的电流反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 galvanize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sharp piercing cry

examples.en: A piercing shriek echoed through the dark corridor, startling everyone inside.
examples.zh: 一声刺耳的尖叫在黑暗的走廊里回荡，吓了里面的所有人一跳。

lemmas.usage_note: 指因恐惧、疼痛或极度兴奋发出的尖叫声或尖锐机械声，常与 of 连用（如 shriek of delight）。

lemmas.def_zh: 尖叫, 发尖声；尖声发出
lemmas.def_en: utter a shrill cry

examples.en: The passengers shrieked in terror as the roller coaster suddenly plunged downward.
examples.zh: 当过山车突然俯冲向下时，乘客们惊恐地尖叫起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，指发出尖叫或尖声喊出某话，常与 with 或 at 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shriek 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: causing abrasion

examples.en: His abrasive manner alienates many colleagues who otherwise respect his technical expertise.
examples.zh: 他那生硬粗鲁的处事方式疏远了许多本应敬重其专业技能的同事。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指物质具有研磨、磨蚀作用，也常用作比喻，形容人的性格或说话方式粗鲁伤人、生硬刺耳。

lemmas.def_en: a substance that abrades or wears down

examples.en: Workers used an industrial abrasive to smooth out the rough edges of the metal pipe.
examples.zh: 工人们使用一种工业研磨剂来打磨平滑金属管道的粗糙边缘。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用于研磨、打磨或抛光表面的金刚砂等研磨剂或抛光料，通常为可数或不可数工业名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 磨擦, 磨损, 磨损处
lemmas.def_en: an abraded area where the skin is torn or worn off
the roughness of a substance that causes abrasions
wear away

examples.en: Rough granite rocks can quickly abrade the soles of your hiking boots.
examples.zh: 粗糙的花岗岩石会迅速磨损你的登山靴底。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abrasive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soft loosely twisted thread used in embroidery

examples.en: Dentists strongly recommend using dental floss at least once a day to prevent gum disease.
examples.zh: 牙医强烈建议每天至少使用一次牙线，以预防牙龈疾病。

lemmas.usage_note: 最常指清洁牙缝用的牙线（dental floss），也可指蚕丝屑、棉花糖（candy floss）等纤维状物。

lemmas.def_en: use dental floss to clean

examples.en: Remember to brush your teeth and floss carefully every night before going to bed.
examples.zh: 每天晚上睡觉前，记得仔细刷牙并用牙线清洁牙缝。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指用牙线清洁牙齿（可作及物或不及物动词），也可俚指炫耀财富或跳甩手舞。

lemmas.def_zh: 丝棉似的, 轻软的, 迷人的
lemmas.def_en: like down or as soft as down

family_guide.root_logic: 以 floss 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: something serving to conceal plans; a fictitious reason that is concocted in order to conceal the real reason

examples.en: He resigned under the pretext of poor health, though internal politics was the real reason.
examples.zh: 他以健康不佳为借口辞了职，尽管内部政治斗争才是真正的原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 指掩盖真实意图的借口、托词，核心固定搭配为 on/under the pretext of doing sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pretext 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 谴责, 惩戒, 严责
lemmas.def_en: rebuke formally

examples.en: The manager publicly reprimanded the employee for repeatedly missing critical deadlines.
examples.zh: 经理因该员工屡次延误关键截止日期而当众对他进行了严厉训斥。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，指上级或长辈公开、严厉地批评或申斥某人，常与 for 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reprimand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 古雅的, 离奇有趣的, 奇怪的
lemmas.def_en: strange in an interesting or pleasing way

examples.en: We spent the afternoon strolling through a quaint seaside village filled with antique shops.
examples.zh: 我们在一个古雅迷人、遍布古董店的海滨小村庄里漫步度过了下午。

lemmas.usage_note: 常带褒义，形容事物因古朴、别致或异乎寻常而显得迷人可爱，多修饰小镇、村庄或风俗。

lemmas.def_en: in a strange but not unpleasant manner

examples.en: the old lady expressed herself somewhat quaintly

lemmas.def_zh: 离奇有趣, 古怪的事物
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being quaint and old-fashioned

examples.en: she liked the old cottage; its quaintness was appealing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quaint 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 分叉处, 丫叉, 胯部
lemmas.def_en: the region of the angle formed by the junction of two branches

examples.en: A small bird built its nest securely in the crotch of the old oak tree.
examples.zh: 一只小鸟将窝安安稳稳地筑在那棵老橡树的树杈处。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既可指人体两腿分叉的胯部或裤裆，也可指树木等分支分叉处，语体偏口语或具象描述。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crotch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乖张的, 故意作对的, 有悖常情的, 执迷不悟的, 歪曲的, 错误的, 不正当的
lemmas.def_en: marked by a disposition to oppose and contradict

examples.en: She seemed to take a perverse pleasure in disagreeing with everything anyone said.
examples.zh: 她似乎从故意反驳所有人说的每一句话中获得了一种病态的满足。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，常修饰人或行为，指明知不妥却故意逆向而行、固执任性或违背常理的情形。

lemmas.def_en: deliberately deviant

examples.en: his perversely erotic notions

lemmas.def_zh: 乖僻, 倔强, 任性, 反常, 性变态
lemmas.def_en: deliberate and stubborn unruliness and resistance to guidance or discipline
deliberate and stubborn unruliness and resistance to guidance or discipline

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perverse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不切实际的, 不能实行的, 不现实的, 不合情理的
lemmas.def_en: not practical; not workable or not given to practical matters

examples.en: Wearing high heels for a mountain hike is entirely impractical and potentially hazardous.
examples.zh: 穿着高跟鞋去爬山是极其不切实际的，而且还可能带来危险。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述想法、计划或方案脱离实际、缺乏可行性，或指人不善于处理实际事务。

lemmas.def_en: concerned with theoretical possibilities rather than actual use

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impractical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 山楂, 吆喝牲畜左转, 呃, 瞬膜
lemmas.def_en: a spring-flowering shrub or small tree of the genus Crataegus

examples.en: Bright red haws covered the thorny hedges throughout the late autumn.
examples.zh: 深秋时节，鲜红的山楂果实挂满了带刺的树篱。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，主要指山楂树的红色果实；在农事中指赶牲口左转的口令；亦可指鸟兽眼球的瞬膜。

lemmas.def_en: utter `haw'

examples.en: The farmer called out firmly to haw the team of oxen toward the ditch.
examples.zh: 农夫果断地大声吆喝，让那队牛向左转朝沟渠走去。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于农耕语境，指驱赶役畜向左转，或指牲口自身向左转向；亦可与 hum 构成搭配指支吾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marry, not for the first time

examples.en: Years after her husband passed away, she decided to remarry and start a new life.
examples.zh: 在丈夫去世多年后，她决定再婚并开启一段崭新的生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作不及物动词表示“再次结婚”，也可用作及物动词接宾语，通常在离婚或丧偶后使用。

lemmas.def_en: the act of marrying again

family_guide.root_logic: 以 remarry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a member of a group of English Protestants who in the 16th and 17th centuries thought that the Protestant Reformation under Elizabeth was incomplete and advocated the simplification and regulation of forms of worship

examples.en: He was such a puritan that he considered going to the cinema on a weekday a sinful waste of time.
examples.zh: 他是个极度禁欲克己的人，甚至认为在工作日看电影是罪恶的浪费时间。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史学指英美清教徒；日常中多带轻微贬义，指生活极其严谨、排斥享乐的道德苛求者。

lemmas.def_zh: 清教徒的, 清教主义的, 宗教上极端拘谨的, 道德上极端拘谨的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Puritans or Puritanism

family_guide.root_logic: 以 puritan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a male member of a religious order that originally relied solely on alms

examples.en: The gentle friar devoted his entire life to ministering to the sick and feeding the poor.
examples.zh: 这位温和的托钵修士将毕生精力奉献于照顾病患和救济穷人。

lemmas.usage_note: 宗教专用词汇，特指天主教托钵修会（如方济各会、多明我会等）中出外传教的修士。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 friar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光辉, 壮丽, 显赫
lemmas.def_en: a quality that outshines the usual

examples.en: The newly restored cathedral was revealed in all its architectural splendor.
examples.zh: 新修复的大教堂将其全部的建筑之壮美完整地展现在世人面前。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语名，常用于描写宫殿、自然奇观或盛大仪式的富丽堂皇、雄伟壮观或灿烂辉煌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 splendor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 把...分开, 分离, 游离, 分裂
lemmas.def_en: part; cease or break association with

examples.en: The politician tried to dissociate himself from the extremist remarks made by his supporter.
examples.zh: 这位政客试图与支持者发表的极端言论划清界限。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词from连用，表示“澄清关系”或“使脱离”，多用于正式声明或学术心理学语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 分解, 分离, 脱离关系
lemmas.def_en: the act of removing from association
tending to produce dissociation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dissociate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 中凸的, 凸圆的, 凸面的
lemmas.def_en: curving or bulging outward

examples.en: Security staff rely on a convex mirror at the corner to monitor blind spots.
examples.zh: 安保人员依靠转角处的凸面镜来监控盲区。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技与几何用语，常修饰lens（透镜）、mirror（镜面）或surface，与concave相对。

lemmas.def_zh: 中凸, 凸状, 凸面
lemmas.def_en: the property possessed by a convex shape
in a convex way

examples.en: bulging out convexly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 convex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 最后通牒, 基本原理
lemmas.def_en: a final peremptory demand

examples.en: The management issued an ultimatum to the striking workers to return to their posts by noon.
examples.zh: 管理层向罢工工人发出最后通牒，要求他们在中午前重返工作岗位。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式政治与商务用语，常与动词issue、deliver或give搭配，复数可作ultimatums或ultimata。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ultimatum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cause an eclipse of (a celestial body) by intervention

examples.en: The Moon will occult the bright star Aldebaran for approximately forty minutes tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚月球将掩蔽毕宿五这颗亮星约四十分钟。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词多用于天文学或正式文体，表示某一天体遮掩另一天体，或指隐匿、遮蔽事物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 occult 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone with a sociopathic personality; a person with an antisocial personality disorder (`psychopath' was once widely used but has now been superseded by `sociopath')

examples.en: The detective realized the killer was a cold-blooded sociopath who felt no remorse for his crimes.
examples.zh: 侦探意识到这名凶手是一个冷血的反社会分子，对其罪行毫无悔意。

lemmas.usage_note: 心理学与通俗法律用词，指缺乏同理心且具反社会人格者，多带贬义，常作主语或宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: 反社会的, 不爱社交的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a sociopathic personality disorder

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sociopath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: display proudly; act ostentatiously or pretentiously

examples.en: He loved to flaunt his newly acquired wealth by driving luxury sports cars around town.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在城里开着豪华跑车到处转，以此炫耀他新获得的财富。

lemmas.usage_note: 含贬义，常接wealth、success等名词作宾语，表示招摇、炫耀，常用于俗语flaunt it。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flaunt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: represent as less significant or important

examples.en: The spokesperson attempted to downplay the severity of the economic crisis during the briefing.
examples.zh: 发言人在通报会上试图淡化这场经济危机的严重性。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与risks、importance、significance搭配，意为故意淡化或低估某事严重性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downplay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tall slender dog of an ancient breed noted for swiftness and keen sight; used as a racing dog

examples.en: Built for speed, the ocean liner was hailed as a magnificent greyhound of the Atlantic.
examples.zh: 这艘为速度而建的远洋班轮被誉为大西洋上一艘卓越的飞速巨轮。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为灵缇犬，航海和交通中常借指高速客船或快艇，多以修辞性比喻出现在特指语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greyhound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可逆的, 不可改变的, 不能倒置的, 不能翻转的, 不能倒转的, 不可撤销的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being reversed

examples.en: Scientists warn that continued deforestation will cause irreversible damage to global biodiversity.
examples.zh: 科学家警告说，持续的森林砍伐将对全球生物多样性造成不可逆的破坏。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰damage、decline、change或loss等消极名词，强调无法逆转、无法挽回的状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可逆性, 不可改变性
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being irreversible (once done it cannot be changed)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 irreversible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having unsuitable feminine qualities

examples.en: He refused to wear the floral scarf, dismissing it as a sissy accessory for a real athlete.
examples.zh: 他拒绝戴那条碎花围巾，认为那是真正的运动员绝不碰的娘娘腔饰物。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式且带贬义，用作定语修饰行为、衣服或态度，意为“娘娘腔的”或“不坚强的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 女孩子, 女人腔的男人, 胆小鬼
lemmas.def_en: a timid man or boy considered childish or unassertive

examples.en: The older boys mocked him and called him a sissy when he started crying over a scraped knee.
examples.zh: 当他因为擦破膝盖哭起来时，大一点的男孩们嘲笑他是个胆小鬼。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式贬义词，常用于口语嘲讽胆小懦弱或举止女性化的男性，常与动词call连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sissy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无差别的, 任意的, 杂乱的
lemmas.def_en: failing to make or recognize distinctions

examples.en: The human rights organization strongly condemned the indiscriminate bombing of residential areas.
examples.zh: 人权组织强烈谴责了对居民区进行的无差别轰炸。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 violence, attack 或 use，含贬义，指缺乏辨别力或不加节制的行为，多用于正式语体。

lemmas.def_zh: 无差别, 任意地; 不分青红皂白地; 滥; 不分皂白
lemmas.def_en: in a random manner

examples.en: the houses were randomly scattered
bullets were fired into the crowd at random

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indiscriminate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 直立, 发怒, 充满；使直立
lemmas.def_en: be in a state of movement or action

examples.en: She visibly bristled at his patronizing remark and refused to answer any further questions.
examples.zh: 面对他居高临下的评价，她明显被激怒了，拒绝回答任何后续问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 at 连用表示“因…发怒”，或与 with 连用表示“充满/密布”，多用于书面语和生动描写中。

lemmas.def_en: a stiff fiber (coarse hair or filament); natural or synthetic

examples.en: The artist prefers oil painting brushes made with stiff natural hog bristles.
examples.zh: 这位画家更喜欢用质地硬挺的天然猪鬃制作的油画笔。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作可数名词，指动物的硬毛或刷毛，常见搭配如 nylon/hog bristles，多用于日常生活语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 有刚毛的, 如刚毛的, 易怒的
lemmas.def_en: very irritable

examples.en: His chin felt rough and bristly because he had forgotten to shave today.
examples.zh: 因为今天忘了刮胡子，他的下巴感觉粗糙且胡茬扎手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bristle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽阔区域, 宽阔, 天空
lemmas.def_en: a wide scope

examples.en: A vast expanse of barren desert stretched out before the weary travelers.
examples.zh: 一片广袤无垠的荒漠在疲惫的旅人面前绵延开来。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作可数名词且常与 vast, wide 搭配，指一望无际的开阔区域，多用于文学描写或正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 expanse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 四倍的, 四重的, 四部分组成的
lemmas.def_en: having four units or components

examples.en: The figure skater made history by landing a clean quadruple jump in the finals.
examples.zh: 这位花样滑冰选手在决赛中干净利落地完成了一个四周跳，创造了历史。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语修饰名词，表示“四倍的”或“四部分的”，如 quadruple jump（花滑四周跳），常用于正式或体育语境。

lemmas.def_en: increase fourfold

examples.en: Driven by strong demand, the company's profits quadrupled over the past two years.
examples.zh: 在强劲需求的推动下，该公司的利润在过去两年内翻了四倍。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，表示数量增加到四倍，常用于经济、商业及统计数据报告等正式语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quadruple 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cheeselike food made of curdled soybean milk

examples.en: The chef tossed the diced firm tofu in garlic sauce before searing it in a hot pan.
examples.zh: 大厨将切成小块的老豆腐拌入蒜蓉酱汁，然后放入热锅中煎至金黄。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作不可数名词，指豆制品豆腐，常见搭配如 firm/silken/fried tofu，广泛用于日常饮食语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tofu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a weathered and decomposed siliceous limestone; in powdered form it is used in polishing

examples.en: The craftsman rubbed fine tripoli onto the brass surface to achieve a mirror-like polish.
examples.zh: 工匠将细腻的硅藻土涂抹在黄铜表面进行擦拭，以达到镜面般的抛光效果。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业技术名词，作不可数名词，指用于研磨和抛光的硅藻土或硅质粉末，常见于工业和制造语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tripoli 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 求援, 求助, 追索权
lemmas.def_en: act of turning to for assistance

examples.en: They managed to resolve the contract dispute through mediation without recourse to legal action.
examples.zh: 他们通过调解妥善解决了合同纠纷，未曾诉诸法律手段。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 have recourse to 或 without recourse to 搭配，意为“求助/依托于”，多见于正式或法律语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recourse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可移去的, 可免职的, 可移动的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being removed or taken away or dismissed

examples.en: The new smartphone is equipped with a removable battery for easy replacement on the go.
examples.zh: 这款新智能手机配备了可拆卸电池，方便外出时随时更换。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 part, cover, battery 等，表示“可拆卸的”或“可移除的”，多用于说明书及产品描述语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 removable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an outlying farm

examples.en: The family spent their summer holidays in a historic grange nestled in the English countryside.
examples.zh: 一家人在坐落于英格兰乡村的一处历史悠久的庄园里度过了暑假。

lemmas.usage_note: 指附带附属建筑物的农庄或大田庄，常见于英式英语或文学描写中，有时也指美国农民联谊会组织。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grange 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适当的, 过度的, 未到期的
lemmas.def_en: not yet payable

examples.en: The judge warned the defense team not to exert undue influence on the key witness.
examples.zh: 法官警告辩护律师团队不得对关键证人施加不当影响。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作前置定语修饰 delay, pressure, influence 或 hardship，意为“过度的/不恰当的”，多用于法律及正式文体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 野生的, 凶猛的, 野兽的
lemmas.def_en: wild and menacing

examples.en: The island is overrun by feral cats that pose a serious threat to native bird species.
examples.zh: 岛上到处都是野猫，对当地的本土鸟类构成了严重威胁。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰逃逸驯化重返野生的动植物，亦可比喻人野性未驯、凶残狂野，多用于书面语和生物学语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 feral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 迎合高层次消费者的；质优价高的
lemmas.def_en: appropriate for people with good incomes

examples.en: They opened an upscale boutique in the city's most affluent shopping district.
examples.zh: 他们在该市最富庶的商业区开了一家高档精品店。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作前置定语修饰商铺、社区或消费品，指面向高收入群体的高档次、高价位，具褒义商业色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upscale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small being, human in form, playful and having magical powers

examples.en: In the ancient legend, a gentle fay appeared to guide travelers lost in the enchanted woods.
examples.zh: 在古老的传说中，一位温柔的小仙子现身引导迷失在魔法森林中的旅人。

lemmas.usage_note: 指童话或民间传说中的小仙子、精灵，属于古旧或诗歌体词汇，现代英语中多见于奇幻文学作品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 开(尔文)SI热力学温度单位; 符号K
lemmas.def_en: the basic unit of thermodynamic temperature adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

examples.en: Absolute zero is defined as zero kelvins, the theoretical temperature at which molecular motion ceases.
examples.zh: 绝对零度被定义为零开尔文，是分子运动完全停止的理论温度。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理学与化学中绝对温度的国际标准单位，常用于科学计量，大写符号为K，数值后通常不加度数符号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kelvin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: present at birth but not necessarily hereditary; acquired during fetal development

examples.en: The infant underwent corrective surgery shortly after birth to repair a congenital heart defect.
examples.zh: 这个婴儿在出生后不久便接受了矫正手术，以修复先天性心脏缺陷。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指出生即具备的（常与defect/disease连用），亦可幽默或贬义地比喻人本性如此、积习难改。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 congenital 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an acute intestinal infection caused by ingestion of contaminated water or food

examples.en: Contaminated drinking water triggered a massive outbreak of cholera in the flood-affected region.
examples.zh: 受污染的饮用水在受洪灾影响的地区引发了大规模的霍乱爆发。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指由霍乱弧菌引起的严重急性肠道传染病，常与outbreak、epidemic连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cholera 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a laminate made of thin layers of wood

examples.en: The carpenter used sheets of marine plywood to construct the waterproof cabinet.
examples.zh: 木匠使用了几张船用胶合板来制作这个防水储物柜。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指将多层木薄板胶合压制而成的胶合板，广泛用于建筑构件、家具制造和简易装潢中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plywood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: skintight knit hose covering the body from the waist to the feet worn by acrobats and dancers and as stockings by women and girls

examples.en: She wore thick woollen tights under her coat to keep warm during the cold winter morning.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬日早晨，她在外套里面穿了厚羊毛连裤袜以保暖。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用复数形式，英式英语中多指连裤袜，亦可指舞蹈演员或运动员穿着的紧身裤，修饰时用a pair of。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tights 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a notebook containing descriptions and diagrams of the plays that a team has practiced (especially an American football team)

examples.en: The marketing team created a new digital playbook to respond swiftly to consumer trends.
examples.zh: 市场营销团队制定了一套新的数字化策略方案，以迅速应对消费趋势的变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 原指收录戏剧剧本的本子，现常在体育或商政语境中引申指预先制定的战术手册或策略方案集。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playbook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 苦干的, 不辞辛劳的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by hard work and perseverance

examples.en: The company rewarded the hardworking employees with bonuses for exceeding their annual targets.
examples.zh: 公司向勤奋工作的员工发放了奖金，以奖励他们超额完成年度目标。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用褒义形容词，修饰人、团队或群体，表示工作勤奋、埋头苦干，既可作前置定语也可作表语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hardworking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tropical American thorny shrub or small tree; fragrant yellow flowers used in making perfumery

examples.en: Cassie decided to study environmental science after volunteering at the national park.
examples.zh: 卡西在国家公园做志愿者后，决定攻读环境科学专业。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为专有名词通常用作女性教名（Cassandra等的昵称）；普通名词时可指金合欢属灌木芳香油。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cassie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very hot and finely tapering pepper of special pungency

examples.en: He added a finely chopped red chilli to the curry to give it an extra kick.
examples.zh: 他在咖喱里加了一个切碎的红辣椒，使其口感更刺激。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作可数或不可数名词，英式拼作chilli，常见搭配如chilli powder（辣椒粉）、green chilli。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chilli 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: paper cut to an appropriate size for writing letters; usually with matching envelopes

examples.en: The company ordered personalized office stationery printed with their new logo.
examples.zh: 公司订购了印有新标志的定制办公文具。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，统指信纸、信封、笔等文具用品，注意勿与形容词stationary（静止的）混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stationery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: financial return or reward (especially returns equal to the initial investment)

examples.en: The financial analyst calculated that the solar panel project would have a three-year payback.
examples.zh: 财务分析师测算出该太阳能电池板项目的投资回收期为三年。

lemmas.usage_note: 商科中常指投资回收期（payback period）；日常语境中也可指回报、报应或报复，多作不可数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 payback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood of any of various mahogany trees; much used for cabinetwork and furniture

examples.en: The dining table was crafted from solid mahogany and polished to a rich shine.
examples.zh: 这张餐桌由实心桃花心木制成，打磨得光泽浓郁。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词，指珍贵的桃花心木木材，也可指红褐色；作定语修饰家具极为常见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mahogany 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ludicrous, foolish

examples.en: The inventor is known for coming up with wacky gadgets that surprisingly work.
examples.zh: 这位发明家以构想那些古怪离奇却意外好用的小玩意儿而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语形容词，意为古怪荒谬但常带滑稽、有趣色彩，常修饰idea、humor、costume等。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wacky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the circulating life energy that in Chinese philosophy is thought to be inherent in all things; in traditional Chinese medicine the balance of negative and positive forms in the body is believed to be essential for good health

examples.en: Acupuncture is believed to restore health by balancing the flow of qi throughout the body.
examples.zh: 人们认为针灸能通过平衡全身“气”的流动来恢复健康。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自汉语借词的不可数名词，专指中医或传统哲学中的“气”（生命能量），常与flow、circulate连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 qi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the shedding of blood resulting in murder

examples.en: Diplomats worked through the night to negotiate a ceasefire and avoid further bloodshed.
examples.zh: 外交官们彻夜谈判以促成停火，避免更多的流血事件。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数书面语名词，指战争、暴力冲突中的杀戮或流血事件，常与avoid、prevent、end搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bloodshed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a village in southwestern England where cheddar cheese was first made

examples.en: She grated some sharp cheddar over the pasta before putting it into the oven.
examples.zh: 她在意面上擦碎了一些浓味切达干酪，然后将其放入烤箱。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词（可大写首字母），指切达干酪，常用搭配如mature cheddar（陈年切达）、mild cheddar。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cheddar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 19th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: In physics, the Greek letter tau is commonly used to denote proper time or shear stress.
examples.zh: 在物理学中，希腊字母tau常被用来表示固有时或剪切应力。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技与学术用语，指希腊字母表中第19个字母（Τ/τ），物理中常代表微观粒子或时间常数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tau 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a white or colorless vitreous insoluble solid (SiO2); various forms occur widely in the earth's crust as quartz or cristobalite or tridymite or lechatelierite

examples.en: These tiny packets contain silica gel to absorb moisture and keep the leather shoes dry.
examples.zh: 这些小包装袋里装有硅胶，用以吸收水分并保持皮鞋干燥。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技与地质高频词，不可数，常用于材料科学中，常见搭配有 crystalline silica 或 silica gel。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or containing or resembling silica

examples.en: gritrock is siliceous sandstone

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silica 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: necessary for relief or supply

examples.en: He unfortunately lacked the requisite skills to manage such a complex international project.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，他缺乏管理这样一个复杂的国际项目所必需的技能。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常前置修饰名词或与 to/for 连用，表示达到某目标所“必需的、不可或缺的”。

lemmas.def_zh: 必需品, 要素, 必要物品
lemmas.def_en: anything indispensable

examples.en: A good working knowledge of statistics is an essential requisite for this research post.
examples.zh: 熟练掌握统计学知识是应聘这个研究岗位的必要条件。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常作复数 requisites，常与介词 of 或 for 连用，指实现某事物不可缺少的条件或物品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 requisite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕的, 令人毛骨悚然的, 阴森的
lemmas.def_en: shockingly repellent; inspiring horror

examples.en: The newspaper decided not to publish the gruesome details of the fatal traffic accident.
examples.zh: 这家报社决定不公布这起致命交通事故中令人毛骨悚然的细节。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰涉及死亡、暴力或伤口的场景，带有强烈的恐怖感，高频搭配 gruesome murder/details。

lemmas.def_en: in a gruesome manner

examples.en: he was gruesomely wounded

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being ghastly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gruesome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 波美拉尼亚种小狗, 砰的一声
lemmas.def_en: a disparaging term for a British person

examples.en: She walked into the park carrying a tiny, fluffy Pom under her arm.
examples.zh: 她胳膊下夹着一只毛茸茸的小博美犬走进了公园。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用名词，多作 Pomeranian（博美犬）的昵称缩写；在澳新俚语中首字母大写指英国人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: transfer somebody to a different position or location of work

examples.en: The manager decided to reassign him to the marketing department after the restructuring.
examples.zh: 部门重组后，经理决定将他重新分配到市场部。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于职场或管理语境，常见搭配为 reassign sb to sth 或 reassign tasks/roles。

lemmas.def_en: assignment to a different duty

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reassign 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bring shame or dishonor upon

examples.en: His corrupt actions did not just ruin his career; they dishonored his entire family.
examples.zh: 他的腐败行径不仅毁掉了自己的职业生涯，还玷污了整个家族的名誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，及物动词，指使蒙羞或败坏名誉；商业语境中可指拒付支票，搭配 dishonor a cheque。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dishonor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阴沉的, 凄凉的, 令人忧郁的
lemmas.def_en: causing dejection

examples.en: The company reported dismal financial results after months of declining sales.
examples.zh: 在经历了数月的销售额下滑后，该公司公布了惨淡的财务业绩。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容天气、处境或业绩极其惨淡低迷，常见搭配 dismal weather/failure/record。

lemmas.def_en: in a cheerless manner

examples.en: in August 1914 , there was a dismally sentimental little dinner, when the French, German, Austrian and Belgian members of the committee drank together to the peace of the future

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dismal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an upright that is a member in a door or window frame

examples.en: We climbed over a wooden stile and continued our walk across the open meadow.
examples.zh: 我们翻过一个木制阶梯架，继续漫步穿过开阔的草地。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指乡间供行人跨越栅栏、围墙但能防牲畜跑出的台阶或横木，常见搭配 climb over a stile。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a blast of a horn

examples.en: The driver gave a quick toot of the horn to warn the pedestrians ahead.
examples.zh: 司机短促地按了一声喇叭，以提醒前面的行人。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指鸣笛或吹奏发出的短促清脆声，常与动词 give/blow 连用，如 give a toot on the horn。

lemmas.def_en: make a loud noise

examples.en: A passing motorist tooted impatiently at the cyclist blocking the narrow lane.
examples.zh: 一名路过的汽车司机不耐烦地向挡住狭窄车道的骑车人按响了喇叭。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，表示吹喇叭或短促鸣笛，常见搭配 toot a horn 或 toot at sb。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 憎恶, 痛恨, 回避, 拒绝
lemmas.def_en: find repugnant

examples.en: As a lifelong pacifist, she abhors all forms of violence and armed conflict.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的和平主义者，她对一切形式的暴力和武装冲突深恶痛绝。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，及物动词，后接名词或动名词，表示出于道德原则或强烈反感而深恶痛绝，不用于进行时。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人憎恨的, 可恶的, 厌恶的, 相抵触的, 不一致的
lemmas.def_en: offensive to the mind

examples.en: an abhorrent deed
the obscene massacre at Wounded Knee

lemmas.def_en: hate coupled with disgust

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abhor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 兴高采烈, 着迷, 欢天喜地, 狂喜
lemmas.def_en: a state of being carried away by overwhelming emotion; - Charles Dickens

examples.en: The audience listened in rapture as the violinist played the final, haunting notes.
examples.zh: 当小提琴手奏出最后几个动人心魄的音符时，听众们听得如痴如醉。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语中表示狂喜或极度欢悦，常与介词in或into搭配，如in rapture或go into raptures。

lemmas.def_zh: 兴高采烈的, 狂喜的, 欢天喜地的
lemmas.def_en: feeling great rapture or delight

lemmas.def_zh: 兴高采烈地, 狂喜地
lemmas.def_en: in an ecstatic manner

examples.en: he reacted ecstatically to my plan to travel to Africa

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rapture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a remedy that stops or controls the effects of a poison

examples.en: Laughter is often praised as the best natural antidote to daily stress and anxiety.
examples.zh: 笑声常被称赞为缓解日常压力与焦虑的最佳天然良药。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指解毒剂，引申指消除不良影响的对策，后常接介词to或against，构成antidote to sth搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antidote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 潦草地书写, 乱写, 滥写
lemmas.def_en: write down quickly without much attention to detail

examples.en: She hurriedly scribbled down his phone number on a scrap of paper before he walked away.
examples.zh: 在他走开之前，她匆忙将他的电话号码胡乱记在了一张小纸片上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物或不及物动词，指快速且潦草地书写或涂鸦，常见短语有scribble down（匆匆记下）。

lemmas.def_zh: 潦草书写的人, 三流作家, 小文人
lemmas.def_en: informal terms for journalists

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scribble 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 切口, 切割, 雕刻, 切入
lemmas.def_en: a depression scratched or carved into a surface

examples.en: The surgeon made a small, precise incision just below the patient's rib cage.
examples.zh: 外科医生在患者肋骨下方切开了一个精准的小切口。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于医学外科语境，指手术切口，常与动词make搭配，表示“切开刀口”。

lemmas.def_en: keenness and forcefulness of thought or expression or intellect
make an incision into by carving or cutting

examples.en: The craftsman used a sharp chisel to carefully incise delicate patterns into wood.
examples.zh: 手艺人用锋利的凿子小心翼翼地在木头上雕刻出精致的图案。

lemmas.def_zh: 敏锐的, 机敏的, 激烈的, 切入的, 锋利的
lemmas.def_en: having or demonstrating ability to recognize or draw fine distinctions

examples.en: an acute observer of politics and politicians
incisive comments

lemmas.def_en: in an incisive manner

examples.en: he was incisively critical

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incision 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 围裹, 抑制, 发低沉的声音
lemmas.def_en: conceal or hide

examples.en: Thick velvet curtains were hung along the walls to muffle the loud traffic noise from the street.
examples.zh: 墙上挂着厚重的丝绒窗帘，以减弱街上传来的嘈杂交通噪音。

lemmas.usage_note: 指通过包裹、遮盖使声音变得低沉模糊，或用厚衣物包裹保暖，多用于被动语态或及物动词结构。

lemmas.def_zh: 围巾, 头巾, 无指手套, 消声器
lemmas.def_en: a tubular acoustic device inserted in the exhaust system that is designed to reduce noise

lemmas.def_zh: adj. （声音）压低的，听不清的，闷声的
lemmas.def_en: quiet and not distinct or clear because of being deadened by something
lemmas.usage_note: 主要修饰声音，如 a muffled cough / voice / sound。

examples.en: We could hear muffled voices coming from the next room.
examples.zh: 我们能听到隔壁房间传来隐隐约约的说话声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 muffle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使混淆, 使狼狈, 挫败
lemmas.def_en: be confusing or perplexing to; cause to be unable to think clearly

examples.en: The unexpected election results confounded political analysts across the entire nation.
examples.zh: 出人意料的选举结果令全国的政治分析人士深感困惑。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语动词，表示使人惊愕困惑，或指挫败敌手、混淆概念，常与expectations搭配表示出乎意料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 confound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a guardian or defender against theft or illegal practices or waste

examples.en: The consumer rights watchdog launched an investigation into the company's misleading advertisements.
examples.zh: 消费者权益监督机构对该公司的误导性广告展开了调查。

lemmas.usage_note: 指看门狗，更多引申为监督机构或监察人员，常作定语修饰agency、committee或body。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 watchdog 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ancient Numidian town in northwestern Africa adjoining present-day Annaba in northeastern Algeria

examples.en: We watched a baby hippo splashing playfully in the mud by the riverbank.
examples.zh: 我们看着一只小河马在河岸边的泥浆里欢快地扑腾。

lemmas.usage_note: hippopotamus的非正式口语缩写，可数名词，用于日常生活、儿童读物及通俗语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hippo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (橄榄球中)扭夺, 并列争球
lemmas.def_en: (rugby) the method of beginning play in which the forwards of each team crouch side by side with locked arms; play starts when the ball is thrown in between them and the two sides compete for possession

examples.en: A chaotic scrum of reporters gathered outside the courthouse, eager to interview the defendant.
examples.zh: 一群记者混乱地挤在法院门外，急切地想采访被告。

lemmas.usage_note: 橄榄球术语，指并列争球；日常引申为拥挤混乱的人群，常与of连用，如a scrum of photographers。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scrum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使高兴, 使愉快, 鼓励
lemmas.def_en: fill with sublime emotion

examples.en: The cold mountain breeze and the breathtaking view never failed to exhilarate the hikers.
examples.zh: 凛冽的山风和摄人心魄的美景总能让登山者们精神振奋。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指使人极其兴奋、精神振奋，其过去分词exhilarated常作形容词描述人的状态。

lemmas.def_en: the feeling of lively and cheerful joy

examples.en: he could hardly conceal his excitement when she agreed

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exhilarate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发出尖叫声, 高声埋怨；用尖声说
lemmas.def_en: utter a high-pitched cry, characteristic of pigs

examples.en: The children began to squeal with delight as the colorful puppies ran outside.
examples.zh: 当色彩斑斓的小狗跑出来时，孩子们高兴得尖叫起来。

lemmas.def_zh: 告密者, 尖叫的动物, 雏鸟
lemmas.def_en: one who reveals confidential information in return for money

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squeal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一队, 一团, 地方武装团队
lemmas.def_en: a temporary police force

examples.en: The sheriff quickly gathered a posse of armed volunteers to pursue the fugitive.
examples.zh: 治安官迅速召集了一队武装志愿者去追捕逃犯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 posse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可怕的, 极讨厌的, 毛骨悚然的
lemmas.def_en: exceedingly bad

examples.en: A horrid smell wafted from the abandoned basement as soon as we opened it.
examples.zh: 我们一打开那个废弃的地下室，一股难闻的气味便扑面而来。

lemmas.def_en: in a hideous manner

examples.en: her face was hideously disfigured after the accident

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horrid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 胆汁, 坏脾气, 暴躁
lemmas.def_en: a digestive juice secreted by the liver and stored in the gallbladder; aids in the digestion of fats

examples.en: The liver continuously produces bile to help break down fats during everyday digestion.
examples.zh: 肝脏持续分泌胆汁，以帮助日常消化过程中分解脂肪。

lemmas.def_zh: 胆汁的, 输送胆汁的, 由于肝功能障碍引起的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or containing bile

examples.en: Gallstones can block the biliary tract and cause severe abdominal pain for patients.
examples.zh: 胆结石会阻塞胆道，给患者造成剧烈的腹痛。

lemmas.def_zh: 患胆(或肝)病的, 胆汁质的, 坏脾气的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or containing bile

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 新纪元, 时代, 时期
lemmas.def_en: a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event

examples.en: The invention of the steam engine marked a revolutionary new epoch in history.
examples.zh: 蒸汽机的发明标志着人类历史进入了一个翻天覆地的新纪元。

lemmas.def_zh: 新纪元的, 划时代的
lemmas.def_en: highly significant or important especially bringing about or marking the beginning of a new development or era

examples.en: epochal decisions made by Roosevelt and Churchill
an epoch-making discovery

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epoch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young female horse under the age of four

examples.en: The spirited young filly dashed effortlessly across the open pasture this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，那匹充满活力的小雌马在开阔的牧场上轻快地飞奔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 filly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large luxurious car; usually driven by a chauffeur

examples.en: A sleek black limousine waited patiently outside the luxury hotel for the diplomats.
examples.zh: 一辆豪华的黑色轿车在奢华酒店外耐心地等待外交官们。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 limousine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 集合, 聚合, 集合体
lemmas.def_en: several things grouped together or considered as a whole

examples.en: The final report is an aggregation of data collected from fifty different studies.
examples.zh: 这份最终报告是五千项不同研究所收集数据的综合汇总。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aggregation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 把...分类, 把...归为一类；协调, 交往
lemmas.def_en: keep company with; hang out with

examples.en: Workers assort the harvested apples by size before packing them into wooden crates.
examples.zh: 工人们在把收获的苹果装入木箱前，先按大小进行分类。

lemmas.def_en: a collection containing a variety of sorts of things

examples.en: The bakery displays an enticing assortment of fresh pastries every single morning.
examples.zh: 这家面包店每天早晨都会陈列出令人垂涎的各色新鲜糕点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 assort 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 博动, 抽动, 颤动
lemmas.def_en: pulsate or pound with abnormal force

examples.en: His temples began to throb with pain after staring at the screen for hours.
examples.zh: 盯着屏幕看了几个小时后，他的太阳穴开始阵阵作痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 throb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (usually plural) the state of having reflex spasms of the diaphragm accompanied by a rapid closure of the glottis producing an audible sound; sometimes a symptom of indigestion

examples.en: Despite a slight technical hiccup at the start, the live presentation went smoothly.
examples.zh: 尽管开头出现了一点技术上的小故障，现场演示依然进行得很顺利。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于复数表示生理性打嗝，单数常引申指商业或计划中短暂出现的微小波折或延误。

lemmas.def_en: breathe spasmodically, and make a sound

examples.en: He drank the icy soda too fast and began to hiccup uncontrollably.
examples.zh: 他冰镇苏打水喝得太急，开始止不住地打嗝。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指连续不由自主地打嗝；也常以现在分词形式作伴随状语或形容词用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hiccup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of astronomy concerned with the physical and chemical properties of celestial bodies

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research in astrophysics helped explain the formation of supermassive black holes.
examples.zh: 她在天体物理学领域的开创性研究有助于解释超大质量黑洞的形成。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数专业名词，指天体物理学，常与 study、department of、advances in 等词搭配。

lemmas.def_en: an astronomer who studies the physical properties of celestial bodies
of or concerned with astrophysics

examples.en: astrophysical sciences

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astrophysics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ignorant or foolish person

examples.en: He felt like a complete booby after locking his keys inside the car for the second time.
examples.zh: 第二次把钥匙锁在车里后，他觉得自己简直是个彻头彻尾的笨蛋。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式用语，多含戏谑或轻蔑意味，常出现于固定搭配 booby prize（安慰奖）中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 booby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marked by foolish or unreasoning fondness

examples.en: It is absurd to waste so much energy arguing over such a potty little detail.
examples.zh: 为这么一个微不足道的细节耗费这么多精力争吵，真是荒谬。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式非正式口语，常指琐碎微不足道的，或口语中引申指略微发疯、古怪的（go potty）。

lemmas.def_en: a plumbing fixture for defecation and urination

examples.en: The toddler proudly announced that she could use the potty all by herself.
examples.zh: 那个刚学会走路的孩子自豪地宣布，她已经能自己使用儿童便盆了。

lemmas.usage_note: 儿童生活用语，指幼儿便盆；常用于 potty training（如厕训练）等复合结构中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 potty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 湿壁画, 湿壁画技法
lemmas.def_en: a mural done with watercolors on wet plaster

examples.en: The Renaissance chapel is famous for its remarkably preserved biblical frescoes.
examples.zh: 这座文艺复兴时期的礼拜堂以其保存极其完好的圣经湿壁画而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 艺术专业名词，复数可用 frescoes 或 frescos，常与 paint、restore 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: paint onto wet plaster on a wall

examples.en: The master artist frescoed the high vaulted ceiling with scenes from ancient mythology.
examples.zh: 这位艺术大师在拱形高顶上以湿壁画技法绘满了古代神话场景。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用湿壁画技法装饰墙面或穹顶，多用于被动语态或艺术史描述语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fresco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 普韦布洛印第安人, 印第安人村庄
lemmas.def_en: a member of any of about two dozen Native American peoples called `Pueblos' by the Spanish because they live in pueblos (villages built of adobe and rock)

examples.en: Tourists gathered to admire the multi-story stone pueblo perched along the desert cliffs.
examples.zh: 游客们聚集在一起，欣赏坐落在沙漠悬崖边的多层石头印第安村落。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史文化名词，首字母大写指普韦布洛族，小写指美洲西南部的土坯多层村落建筑群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pueblo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: presiding officer of a school

examples.en: The headmaster addressed the entire school during the morning assembly.
examples.zh: 校长在早会上向全校师生发表了讲话。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于英式英语，指中小学（尤指私立男校或寄宿学校）的男性校长，女性对应 headmistress。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headmaster 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 心脏地区, 中心地带
lemmas.def_en: the central region of a country or continent; especially a region that is important to a country or to a culture

examples.en: The fertile Midwest is widely recognized as the agricultural heartland of the United States.
examples.zh: 肥沃的中西部地区被公认为美国农业的心脏地带。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指国家或地区的中心地带、核心腹地，或某种文化、政治力量的传统大本营。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heartland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 每十人杀一人, 大批杀害
lemmas.def_en: kill one in every ten, as of mutineers in Roman armies

examples.en: The severe drought decimated local crops, leaving farmers facing ruin.
examples.zh: 严重的干旱大面积摧毁了当地农作物，使农民面临破产境地。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态，形容疾病、战争或灾难对人口、物种或产业造成毁灭性打击。

lemmas.def_zh: 每十人杀一人, 大批杀害
lemmas.def_en: destroying or killing a large part of the population (literally every tenth person as chosen by lot)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decimate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 凸版印刷术, 排印, 印刷版面式样
lemmas.def_en: the craft of composing type and printing from it

examples.en: The website redesign stands out due to its elegant typography and generous white space.
examples.zh: 该网站的改版因其优雅的字体排印和大量留白而脱颖而出。

lemmas.usage_note: 设计与出版领域名词，指字体排印学、排版版面式样，常与 clean、modern 连用。

lemmas.def_en: one who sets written material into type

lemmas.def_zh: 印刷上的, 活版印刷的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or occurring or used in typography

examples.en: the typographic art
a typographical error

lemmas.def_en: relating to or occurring or used in typography

examples.en: the typographic art
a typographical error

lemmas.def_en: in a typographic way

family_guide.root_logic: 以 typography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hamburger with melted cheese on it

examples.en: He ordered a double cheeseburger with a side of crispy fries for lunch.
examples.zh: 他午餐点了一个双层芝士汉堡配一份香脆薯条。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指夹有奶酪的热牛肉汉堡，常与 bacon、fries 等搭配用于日常快餐语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cheeseburger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装有大炮的快速帆船, 护卫舰
lemmas.def_en: a medium size square-rigged warship of the 18th and 19th centuries

examples.en: The navy deployed a guided-missile frigate to escort commercial vessels through the strait.
examples.zh: 海军部署了一艘导弹护卫舰护送商船通过该海峡。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，军事术语，指现代护卫舰或历史上的快速帆船，常与 deploy、patrol 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frigate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several large humped bovids having shaggy manes and large heads and short horns

examples.en: A large herd of bison grazed peacefully across the vast prairie of the national park.
examples.zh: 一大群北美野牛在国家公园辽阔的草原上平静地吃草。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，单复数同形（a bison / herd of bison），多指北美野牛，常用于野生动物保护与生态语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bison 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cylindrical tower used for storing silage

examples.en: The company struggled to foster innovation because departments operated in isolated silos.
examples.zh: 由于各部门各自为政、相互孤立，该公司难以推动创新。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，既指储存谷物或导弹的筒仓，也常比喻组织内部相互隔离的孤立部门（silo mentality）。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reappear on the surface

examples.en: The city council allocated funds to resurface the deteriorating highway downtown.
examples.zh: 市议会拨出资金为市中心年久失修的公路重新铺设路面。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作及物动词表示“给……重铺路面”，也可作不及物动词表示潜水员浮出水面或旧问题重新浮现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 resurface 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 职业, 天命, 天职, 才能, 行业
lemmas.def_en: the particular occupation for which you are trained

examples.en: She felt a true vocation for nursing and dedicated her entire life to patient care.
examples.zh: 她觉得自己天生适合当护士，并把毕生精力奉献给了病患照料事业。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作名词，强调出于使命感、热情或天赋而从事的职业、天职，常接介词 for 或 to do。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vocation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 能想到的, 可相信的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being conceived or imagined or considered

examples.en: The rescue team explored every thinkable option before calling off the search operation.
examples.zh: 救援队在取消搜救行动之前，尝试了所有能想到的方案。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指可以想象的或可能实现的，常见于否定句、最高级或与 unthinkable 形成对比。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能考虑的, 不能想像的, 想像不到的, 不合理的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being conceived or considered

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thinkable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 供给食物, 供养；生存, 存在
lemmas.def_en: support oneself

examples.en: The displaced families were forced to subsist on wild plants and clean rainwater during the blockade.
examples.zh: 在封锁期间，流离失所的家庭被迫依靠野草和清洁雨水勉强维生。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与介词 on 连用（subsist on），表示依靠极少的食物或钱勉强维持生计。

lemmas.def_en: minimal (or marginal) resources for subsisting

examples.en: social security provided only a bare subsistence

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subsist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 电影剧本作家, 编剧家
lemmas.def_en: someone who writes screenplays

examples.en: The talented screenwriter spent months adapting the bestselling novel into a captivating script.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的编剧花了数月时间将这本畅销小说改编成一部引人入胜的剧本。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指电影或电视剧的专业编剧，常见搭配包括 award-winning screenwriter。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 screenwriter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使蒸发, 使排出；蒸发, 散发, 泄露
lemmas.def_en: pass through the tissue or substance or its pores or interstices, as of gas

examples.en: It later transpired that the company's financial records had been deliberately falsified.
examples.zh: 后来人们才得知，该公司的财务记录被蓄意伪造了。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式动词，多用于形式主语结构 it transpires that（事实证明/后来为人所知），或指事情发生、植物蒸腾。

lemmas.def_zh: 蒸发, 排出, 发散, 流逸, 不自觉性出汗
lemmas.def_en: the passage of gases through fine tubes because of differences in pressure or temperature

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transpire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a substance (an atom or molecule or radical or ion) that forms a complex around a central atom

examples.en: The drug acts as a ligand that binds specifically to the receptor on cancer cells.
examples.zh: 该药物作为一种配体，能特异性地与癌细胞表面的受体结合。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学与生物化学专业术语，指与受体或中心金属结合的分子，常与receptor、bind搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ligand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 调合, 捏造, 编造
lemmas.def_en: make a concoction (of) by mixing

examples.en: He had to concoct an elaborate excuse to explain his sudden absence from the meeting.
examples.zh: 他不得不编造一个精心设计的借口，来解释自己为何突然缺席会议。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既指调制特殊混合物，也常用于贬义引申，表示编造谎言、借口或阴谋。

lemmas.def_zh: 调制, 调合, 调合物
lemmas.def_en: any foodstuff made by combining different ingredients

examples.en: he volunteered to taste her latest concoction
he drank a mixture of beer and lemonade

family_guide.root_logic: 以 concoct 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medical science that studies the body's immune system

examples.en: Recent advances in immunology have paved the way for groundbreaking cancer treatments.
examples.zh: 免疫学领域的最新进展为开创性的癌症疗法铺平了道路。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与生物学不可数名词，专指免疫学学科，常见搭配有cellular immunology和clinical immunology。

lemmas.def_en: a medical scientist who specializes in immunology
of or relating to immunology

lemmas.def_zh: 同种异体的, 同种组织移植的
lemmas.def_en: denoting or relating to cells or tissues from individuals belonging to the same species but genetically dissimilar (and hence immunologically incompatible)

examples.en: The leukemia patient required an allogeneic stem cell transplant from a matched donor.
examples.zh: 该白血病患者需要接受来自匹配供体的同种异体干细胞移植。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to immunology
from the point of view of immunology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immunology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 薄酥饼, 圣饼, 晶片, 圆片, 干胶片
lemmas.def_en: a small adhesive disk of paste; used to seal letters

examples.en: The microchips are fabricated on a thin silicon wafer under strict cleanroom conditions.
examples.zh: 这些微芯片是在严格的无尘室环境下于薄硅晶片上制造而成的。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，生活语境指威化薄饼，半导体领域指晶圆或硅片，常与silicon连用构成复合词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wafer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an implement for practical use (especially in a household)

examples.en: Always wash all cooking utensils thoroughly after handling raw meat to prevent contamination.
examples.zh: 处理生肉后，务必彻底清洗所有烹饪用具，以防止交叉污染。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，多指日常特别是厨房用具，最常与kitchen或cooking连用，通常以复数形式出现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 utensil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (baseball) the act of hitting a baseball lightly without swinging the bat

examples.en: The batter laid down a perfect bunt along the third-base line to advance the runner.
examples.zh: 击球手沿着三垒边线打出了一个漂亮的触击球，使跑垒员成功推进。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词主要用于棒球运动中，指短打或触击球，常与lay down a bunt等动词短语搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a batter who bunts
hit a ball in such a way so as to make it go a short distance

examples.en: Instead of swinging for the fences, he decided to bunt the ball toward second base.
examples.zh: 他没有全力挥棒击打全垒打，而是选择将球轻触短打向二垒方向。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作不及物动词也可及物，主要指棒球中短打，偶用于牲畜用头顶撞，常与away或past搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bunt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脆弱的, 虚弱的, 意志薄弱的
lemmas.def_en: physically weak

examples.en: Her grandmother looked frail and vulnerable after spending weeks recovering in the hospital.
examples.zh: 在医院康复了几个星期之后，她的祖母看起来瘦弱而虚弱。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词，多形容老年人身形虚弱脆弱，或指物体易损、意志动摇，常作表语或定语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: place or situation affording some advantage (especially a comprehensive view or commanding perspective)

examples.en: From our vantage on top of the hill, we had an unobstructed view of the harbor.
examples.zh: 从我们山顶的有利位置望去，港口的全貌一览无余。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，几乎总是以固定搭配vantage point（有利观察点、视角）的形式出现在书面语中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vantage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 举起, 拿起, 理解, 上风井, 摄入, 吸收
lemmas.def_en: the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)

examples.en: He may seem quiet in meetings, but he is remarkably quick on the uptake.
examples.zh: 他在会议上可能显得安静，但他的理解领会能力极其敏锐。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，科学语境指吸收/摄入；习语be quick/slow on the uptake指理解力敏锐或迟钝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uptake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 未经说明的, 未经解释的
lemmas.def_en: not explained

examples.en: Scientists are still investigating the unexplained drop in local bird populations.
examples.zh: 科学家们仍在调查当地鸟类数量莫名骤降的原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指未得到明确解释或原因不明的，多作定语修饰mystery、absence或phenomenon。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unexplained 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small golden or orange-red freshwater fishes of Eurasia used as pond or aquarium fishes

examples.en: She kept a single goldfish in a small glass bowl on her desk.
examples.zh: 她在书桌上的小玻璃缸里养了一条金鱼。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指观赏用的小型金鱼，单复数同形，常与 bowl 或 tank 搭配表示鱼缸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goldfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the comfort you feel when consoled in times of disappointment

examples.en: She found solace in music after a long, exhausting week at work.
examples.zh: 在经历了漫长而疲惫的一周工作后，她在音乐中找到了慰藉。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，常与 seek, find, take 连用，后接介词 in，表示在某事中寻求慰藉。

lemmas.def_zh: 安慰, 抚慰, 给与安慰, 使轻松
lemmas.def_en: give moral or emotional strength to

examples.en: He solaced himself with the thought that they would soon be reunited.
examples.zh: 他想到他们很快就会重聚，心中便稍感宽慰。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，较正式或具文学色彩，常接 oneself with/by，表示以某物安慰抚慰自己。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 solace 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 混合, 混杂, 杂录
lemmas.def_en: a musical composition consisting of a series of songs or other musical pieces from various sources

examples.en: The band closed their concert with a lively medley of popular eighties hits.
examples.zh: 乐队以一首欢快的80年代流行金曲串烧结束了演唱会。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指歌曲的联唱、杂烩或气味/风格的混合物，多接介词 of 构成固定搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 medley 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不服从, 不孝, 违反
